  352: export async function calculateAuPay(
  353:   request: CalculationRequestV1<AuPayInput>,
  354:   resolution: AuPayResolution,
  355:   context: AuPayContext,
  356: ): Promise<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>> {
  357:   const canonicalRequestHash = await canonicalHash(request);
  358:   const manifestRefs = [
  359:     resolution.incomeTax.manifestRef,
  360:     resolution.medicare.manifestRef,
  361:     resolution.superGuarantee.manifestRef,
  362:     ...(resolution.stsl ? [resolution.stsl.manifestRef] : []),
  363:     ...(resolution.payg ? [resolution.payg.manifestRef] : []),
  364:   ];
  365:   const base = {
  366:     requestId: request.requestId,
  367:     calculationId: `calc_${canonicalRequestHash.slice(0, 16)}`,
  368:     calculatorId: request.calculatorId,
  369:     calculationClass: "B" as const,
  370:     calculatedAt: context.now,
  371:     engineVersions: { [AU_TAX_ENGINE_ID]: AU_TAX_ENGINE_VERSION, E03: "0.1.0", E04: "0.1.0" },
  372:     rulePacks: manifestRefs,
  373:   };
  374:   const finish = async (
  375:     partial: Omit<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>, keyof typeof base | "integrity">,
  376:   ): Promise<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>> => {
  377:     const withoutIntegrity = { ...base, ...partial };
  378:     return {
  379:       ...withoutIntegrity,
  380:       integrity: { canonicalRequestHash, canonicalResultHash: await canonicalHash(withoutIntegrity) },
  381:     };
  382:   };
  383: 
  384:   const parsed = zAuPayInput.safeParse(request.input);
  385:   if (!parsed.success) {
  386:     return finish({
  387:       status: "invalid",
  388:       warnings: [],
  389:       errors: parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
  390:         code: "PC-VAL-0002",
  391:         severity: "error" as const,
  392:         message: issue.message,
  393:         path: issue.path.map(String),
  394:       })),
  395:       assumptions: [],
  396:       sources: [],
  397:     });
  398:   }
  399: 
  400:   try {
  401:     const { output, warnings, trace } = computeAuPay(parsed.data, resolution);
  402: 
  403:     const reconciliation: ReconciliationV1 = buildReconciliation(parsed.data, output);
  404:     if (!reconciliation.passed) {
  405:       return finish({
  406:         status: "failed",
  407:         warnings,
  408:         errors: [
  409:           {
  410:             code: "PC-REC-0002",
  411:             severity: "error",
  412:             message: "Pay reconciliation failed: components do not sum to gross cash income.",
  413:           },
  414:         ],
  415:         assumptions: [],
  416:         sources: [],
  417:         reconciliation: [reconciliation],
  418:       });
  419:     }
  420: 
  421:     const sources: SourceRef[] = manifestRefs.flatMap((ref) => {
  422:       const pack = [
  423:         resolution.incomeTax.pack,
  424:         resolution.medicare.pack,
  425:         resolution.superGuarantee.pack,
  426:         resolution.stsl?.pack,
  427:         resolution.payg?.pack,
  428:       ].find((p) => p?.rulePackId === ref.rulePackId);
  429:       const source = pack?.sources[0];
  430:       return source
  431:         ? [
  432:             {
  433:               sourceId: source.sourceId,
  434:               title: source.title,
  435:               url: source.url,
  436:               authority: source.authority,
  437:               retrievedAt: source.retrievedAt,
  438:               rulePackId: ref.rulePackId,
  439:             },
  440:           ]
  441:         : [];
  442:     });
  443: 
  444:     const assumptions: AssumptionRecord[] = buildAssumptions(parsed.data, resolution);
  445: 
  446:     return finish({
  447:       status: warnings.some((w) => w.severity === "warning") ? "success_with_warnings" : "success",
  448:       output,
  449:       warnings,
  450:       errors: [],
  451:       assumptions,
  452:       sources,
  453:       ...(request.options.traceLevel !== "none" ? { trace: { level: "full" as const, steps: trace } } : {}),
  454:       reconciliation: [reconciliation],
  455:     });
  456:   } catch (thrown) {
  457:     if (thrown instanceof InvalidPayInputError) {
  458:       return finish({
  459:         status: "invalid",
  460:         warnings: [],
  461:         errors: [{ code: thrown.code, severity: "error", message: thrown.message, path: thrown.path }],
  462:         assumptions: [],
  463:         sources: [],
  464:       });
  465:     }
  466:     if (thrown instanceof RulesUnavailableError || (thrown as { code?: string }).code === "PC-RULE-0004") {
  467:       return finish({
  468:         status: "failed",
  469:         warnings: [],
  470:         errors: [{ code: "PC-RULE-0004", severity: "error", message: (thrown as Error).message }],
  471:         assumptions: [],
  472:         sources: [],
  473:       });
  474:     }
  475:     throw thrown;
  476:   }
  477: }
  478: 
  479: function buildReconciliation(input: AuPayInput, output: AuPayOutput): ReconciliationV1 {
  480:   // net + liability + pre-tax deductions + post-tax deductions must equal
  481:   // gross cash income to the cent (all values already rounded consistently).
  482:   const grossCash = moneyToDecimal(output.annualised.grossCashIncome) as DecimalValue;
  483:   const net = moneyToDecimal(output.netAnnualCash) as DecimalValue;
  484:   const liability = moneyToDecimal(output.liability.totalAnnualLiability) as DecimalValue;
  485:   const preTax = moneyDec(input.adjustments.salarySacrificeSuper).plus(
  486:     moneyDec(input.adjustments.otherPreTaxDeductions),
  487:   ) as DecimalValue;
  488:   const postTax = moneyDec(input.adjustments.postTaxDeductions);
  489:   const reconstructed = net.plus(liability).plus(preTax).plus(postTax) as DecimalValue;
  490:   const difference = reconstructed.minus(grossCash) as DecimalValue;
  491:   return {
  492:     openingAmount: aud(grossCash),
  493:     additions: aud(zero()),
  494:     reductions: aud(liability.plus(preTax).plus(postTax) as DecimalValue),
  495:     closingAmount: aud(net),
  496:     expectedClosingAmount: aud(grossCash.minus(liability).minus(preTax).minus(postTax) as DecimalValue),
  497:     difference: aud(difference),
  498:     tolerance: aud(new Dec("0.02") as DecimalValue),
  499:     passed: difference.abs().lessThanOrEqualTo("0.02"),
  500:   };
  501: }
  502: 
  503: function buildAssumptions(input: AuPayInput, resolution: AuPayResolution): AssumptionRecord[] {
  504:   const sgRate = input.package.employerSuperRate ?? resolution.superGuarantee.pack.rules.rate ?? "unavailable";
  505:   return [
  506:     {
  507:       id: "financial-year-rules",
  508:       label: `Rules for ${input.financialYear}`,
  509:       category: "official_rule",
  510:       value: resolution.incomeTax.pack.rulePackId,
  511:       editable: false,
  512:       materiality: "high",
  513:       sourceId: resolution.incomeTax.pack.sources[0]?.sourceId ?? "",
  514:       explanation: `Income tax, Medicare and study-loan figures use the ${input.financialYear} rule packs listed under Sources.`,
  515:     },
  516:     {
  517:       id: "employer-super-rate",
  518:       label: "Employer super rate",
  519:       category: input.package.employerSuperRate ? "user_input" : "official_rule",
  520:       value: sgRate,
  521:       unit: "rate",
  522:       editable: true,
  523:       materiality: "high",
  524:       explanation:
  525:         input.package.employerSuperRate === null
  526:           ? "The super guarantee rate from the active rule pack."
  527:           : "You overrode the employer super rate.",
  528:     },
  529:     {
  530:       id: "annualisation",
  531:       label: "Annualisation convention",
  532:       category: "contract_setting",
  533:       value: "52 weeks / 26 fortnights / 12 months per year",
  534:       editable: false,

  538:     },

### packages/engine-au-withholding/src/withholding.ts
    1: import { Dec, dec, type DecimalValue } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
    2: import type { CoefficientRow, PaygWithholdingRules } from "@paymentcalcs/rules-au";
    3: 
    4: /**
    5:  * E03 â€” PAYG withholding per the ATO statement of formulas (Schedule 1) and
    6:  * STSL components (Schedule 8). Never annual-tax Ã· periods (Â§13.16).
    7:  *
    8:  * Method (per the schedule):
    9:  *   x = whole dollars of weekly-equivalent earnings + 0.99
   10:  *   y = aÂ·x âˆ’ b for the row bounding the weekly earnings
   11:  *   weekly amount = y rounded to the nearest dollar (50c rounds up)
   12:  *   period amount = weekly Ã—2 (fortnight), Ã—13/3 (month), Ã—13 (quarter)
   13:  */
   14: 
   15: export type WithholdingScaleId =
   16:   | "scale1_no_tft"
   17:   | "scale2_tft"
   18:   | "scale3_foreign"
   19:   | "scale5_full_medicare_exempt"
   20:   | "scale6_half_medicare_exempt";
   21: 
   22: export type WithholdingCycle = "weekly" | "fortnightly" | "monthly" | "quarterly";
   23: 
   24: export class WithholdingRuleUnavailableError extends Error {
   25:   readonly code = "PC-RULE-0004";
   26: }
   27: 
   28: /** Weekly-equivalent x per the schedule's period-conversion rules. */
   29: export function weeklyEquivalentX(periodEarnings: DecimalValue, cycle: WithholdingCycle): DecimalValue {
   30:   const cents99 = new Dec("0.99");
   31:   switch (cycle) {
   32:     case "weekly":
   33:       return periodEarnings.floor().plus(cents99) as DecimalValue;
   34:     case "fortnightly":
   35:       return periodEarnings.div(2).floor().plus(cents99) as DecimalValue;
   36:     case "monthly": {
   37:       const cents = periodEarnings.minus(periodEarnings.floor());
   38:       const adjusted = cents.toFixed(2) === "0.33" ? periodEarnings.plus("0.01") : periodEarnings;
   39:       return adjusted.times(3).div(13).floor().plus(cents99) as DecimalValue;
   40:     }
   41:     case "quarterly":
   42:       return periodEarnings.div(13).floor().plus(cents99) as DecimalValue;
   43:   }
   44: }
   45: 
   46: function rowFor(rows: CoefficientRow[], weeklyX: DecimalValue): CoefficientRow {
   47:   for (const row of rows) {
   48:     if (row.lessThan !== undefined && weeklyX.lessThan(dec(row.lessThan))) return row;
   49:   }
   50:   const terminal = rows.find((row) => row.andOver !== undefined);
   51:   if (terminal) return terminal;
   52:   return rows[rows.length - 1]!;
   53: }
   54: 
   55: /** Nearest-dollar rounding; an exact 50c rounds up (schedule note). */
   56: function roundDollars(amount: DecimalValue): DecimalValue {
   57:   return amount.toDecimalPlaces(0, Dec.ROUND_HALF_UP) as DecimalValue;
   58: }
   59: 
   60: function periodMultiple(weeklyDollars: DecimalValue, cycle: WithholdingCycle): DecimalValue {
   61:   switch (cycle) {
   62:     case "weekly":
   63:       return weeklyDollars;
   64:     case "fortnightly":
   65:       return weeklyDollars.times(2) as DecimalValue;
   66:     case "monthly":
   67:       return roundDollars(weeklyDollars.times(13).div(3) as DecimalValue);
   68:     case "quarterly":
   69:       return weeklyDollars.times(13) as DecimalValue;
   70:   }
   71: }
   72: 
   73: export interface WithholdingComputation {
   74:   scale: WithholdingScaleId;
   75:   weeklyX: string;
   76:   weeklyOrdinary: DecimalValue;
   77:   periodOrdinary: DecimalValue;
   78:   weeklyStsl: DecimalValue;
   79:   periodStsl: DecimalValue;
   80:   periodTotal: DecimalValue;
   81: }
   82: 
   83: export function computeWithholding(
   84:   rules: PaygWithholdingRules,
   85:   options: {
   86:     periodEarnings: DecimalValue;
   87:     cycle: WithholdingCycle;
   88:     scale: WithholdingScaleId;
   89:     stslEnabled: boolean;
   90:   },
   91: ): WithholdingComputation {
   92:   const scaleRows: Record<WithholdingScaleId, CoefficientRow[] | null> = {
   93:     scale1_no_tft: rules.scales.scale1NoTaxFreeThreshold,
   94:     scale2_tft: rules.scales.scale2TaxFreeThreshold,
   95:     scale3_foreign: rules.scales.scale3ForeignResident,
   96:     scale5_full_medicare_exempt: rules.scales.scale5FullMedicareExemption,
   97:     scale6_half_medicare_exempt: rules.scales.scale6HalfMedicareExemption,
   98:   };
   99:   const rows = scaleRows[options.scale];
  100:   if (!rows) throw new WithholdingRuleUnavailableError(`coefficients for ${options.scale} are not populated`);
  101: 
  102:   const x = weeklyEquivalentX(options.periodEarnings, options.cycle);
  103:   const row = rowFor(rows, x);
  104:   const rawWeekly = dec(row.a).times(x).minus(dec(row.b)) as DecimalValue;
  105:   const weeklyOrdinary = roundDollars(
  106:     (Dec.max(new Dec(0) as DecimalValue, rawWeekly) as DecimalValue),
  107:   );
  108:   const periodOrdinary = periodMultiple(weeklyOrdinary, options.cycle);
  109: 
  110:   let weeklyStsl = new Dec(0) as DecimalValue;
  111:   if (options.stslEnabled) {
  112:     // Schedule 8: the no-TFT component table applies only when the tax-free
  113:     // threshold is not claimed (scale 1); all other supported scales use the
  114:     // claimed/foreign table.
  115:     const componentRows =
  116:       options.scale === "scale1_no_tft"
  117:         ? rules.stslComponents.noTaxFreeThreshold
  118:         : rules.stslComponents.taxFreeThresholdOrForeign;
  119:     if (!componentRows) {
  120:       throw new WithholdingRuleUnavailableError("STSL component coefficients are not populated");
  121:     }
  122:     const componentRow = rowFor(componentRows, x);
  123:     const rawStsl = dec(componentRow.a).times(x).minus(dec(componentRow.b)) as DecimalValue;
  124:     weeklyStsl = roundDollars((Dec.max(new Dec(0) as DecimalValue, rawStsl) as DecimalValue));
  125:   }
  126:   const periodStsl = periodMultiple(weeklyStsl, options.cycle);
  127: 
  128:   return {
  129:     scale: options.scale,
  130:     weeklyX: x.toFixed(2),
  131:     weeklyOrdinary,
  132:     periodOrdinary,
  133:     weeklyStsl,
  134:     periodStsl,
  135:     periodTotal: periodOrdinary.plus(periodStsl) as DecimalValue,
  136:   };
  137: }
  138: 
  139: /** Route residency + declarations to the applicable schedule scale. */
  140: export function selectScale(taxpayer: {
  141:   residency: "resident" | "foreign_resident" | "working_holiday_maker";
  142:   claimsTaxFreeThreshold: boolean;
  143:   medicareStatus: "standard" | "half_exemption" | "full_exemption";
  144: }): WithholdingScaleId | { unsupported: string } {
  145:   if (taxpayer.residency === "working_holiday_maker") {
  146:     return {
  147:       unsupported:
  148:         "Working holiday maker withholding follows Schedule 15 and depends on employer registration; it is not yet supported.",
  149:     };
  150:   }
  151:   if (taxpayer.residency === "foreign_resident") return "scale3_foreign";
  152:   if (taxpayer.medicareStatus === "full_exemption") return "scale5_full_medicare_exempt";
  153:   if (taxpayer.medicareStatus === "half_exemption") return "scale6_half_medicare_exempt";
  154:   return taxpayer.claimsTaxFreeThreshold ? "scale2_tft" : "scale1_no_tft";
  155: }
### packages/engine-compensation/src/package-decomposition.ts
    1: import { Dec, dec, type DecimalValue } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
    2: import { bisect, defaultSolverOptions } from "@paymentcalcs/financial-solvers";
    3: import type { SuperGuaranteeRules } from "@paymentcalcs/rules-au";
    4: 
    5: /**
    6:  * E04 â€” salary/package decomposition (Â§12.1.7).
    7:  *
    8:  * The simple closed form base = package Ã· (1 + r) applies only when the whole
    9:  * base is OTE and no maximum-contribution-base effect bites. When the cap
   10:  * applies the employer contribution is r Ã— min(base, cap), which this module
   11:  * solves both in closed form and (as a Â§12.1.7 verification path) iteratively.
   12:  */
   13: 
   14: export class SuperRuleUnavailableError extends Error {
   15:   readonly code = "PC-RULE-0004";
   16: }
   17: 
   18: export interface PackageDecomposition {
   19:   baseSalary: DecimalValue;
   20:   employerSuper: DecimalValue;
   21:   totalPackage: DecimalValue;
   22:   /** "simple_formula" or "capped_contribution_base" or "iterative_solve". */
   23:   method: string;
   24:   capApplied: boolean;
   25:   annualContributionCap: DecimalValue | null;
   26: }
   27: 
   28: export function annualContributionCap(rules: SuperGuaranteeRules): DecimalValue | null {
   29:   if (!rules.maxContributionBase) return null;
   30:   const amount = dec(rules.maxContributionBase.amount);
   31:   return rules.maxContributionBase.basis === "quarterly"
   32:     ? (amount.times(4) as DecimalValue)
   33:     : (amount as DecimalValue);
   34: }
   35: 
   36: /** Employer SG on a given base (annual view). */
   37: export function superOnBase(
   38:   baseSalary: DecimalValue,
   39:   rules: SuperGuaranteeRules,
   40:   applyCap: boolean,
   41: ): DecimalValue {
   42:   if (rules.rate === null) throw new SuperRuleUnavailableError("super guarantee rate is not populated");
   43:   const cap = applyCap ? annualContributionCap(rules) : null;
   44:   const oteBase = cap !== null ? (Dec.min(baseSalary, cap) as DecimalValue) : baseSalary;
   45:   return oteBase.times(dec(rules.rate)) as DecimalValue;
   46: }
   47: 
   48: /** Forward: base salary known, derive super and total package. */
   49: export function packageFromBase(
   50:   baseSalary: DecimalValue,
   51:   rules: SuperGuaranteeRules,
   52:   applyCap: boolean,
   53: ): PackageDecomposition {
   54:   const employerSuper = superOnBase(baseSalary, rules, applyCap);
   55:   const cap = applyCap ? annualContributionCap(rules) : null;
   56:   return {
   57:     baseSalary,
   58:     employerSuper,
   59:     totalPackage: baseSalary.plus(employerSuper) as DecimalValue,
   60:     method: "forward_from_base",
   61:     capApplied: cap !== null && baseSalary.greaterThan(cap),
   62:     annualContributionCap: cap,
   63:   };
   64: }
   65: 
   66: /** Reverse: total package known, derive base (Â§12.1.7). */
   67: export function baseFromPackage(
   68:   totalPackage: DecimalValue,
   69:   rules: SuperGuaranteeRules,
   70:   applyCap: boolean,
   71: ): PackageDecomposition {
   72:   if (rules.rate === null) throw new SuperRuleUnavailableError("super guarantee rate is not populated");
   73:   const rate = dec(rules.rate);
   74:   const cap = applyCap ? annualContributionCap(rules) : null;
   75: 
   76:   const uncappedBase = totalPackage.div(new Dec(1).plus(rate)) as DecimalValue;
   77:   if (cap === null || uncappedBase.lessThanOrEqualTo(cap)) {
   78:     return {
   79:       baseSalary: uncappedBase,
   80:       employerSuper: totalPackage.minus(uncappedBase) as DecimalValue,
   81:       totalPackage,
   82:       method: "simple_formula",
   83:       capApplied: false,
   84:       annualContributionCap: cap,
   85:     };
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   // Cap binds: SG is fixed at r Ã— cap, the remainder of the package is base.
   89:   const employerSuper = cap.times(rate) as DecimalValue;
   90:   const baseSalary = totalPackage.minus(employerSuper) as DecimalValue;
   91:   return {
   92:     baseSalary,
   93:     employerSuper,
   94:     totalPackage,
   95:     method: "capped_contribution_base",
   96:     capApplied: true,
   97:     annualContributionCap: cap,
   98:   };
   99: }
  100: 
  101: /**
  102:  * Iterative Â§12.1.7 verification path: solve base so that
  103:  * base + super(base) = package using E24 bisection. Used by tests to prove
  104:  * the closed forms, and by future package shapes with fixed benefits.
  105:  */
  106: export function baseFromPackageIterative(
  107:   totalPackage: DecimalValue,
  108:   rules: SuperGuaranteeRules,
  109:   applyCap: boolean,
  110: ): PackageDecomposition {
  111:   const result = bisect(
  112:     (base) => base.plus(superOnBase(base, rules, applyCap)).minus(totalPackage) as DecimalValue,
  113:     {
  114:       ...defaultSolverOptions(0, Number(totalPackage.toFixed(0)) + 1),
  115:       absoluteTolerance: new Dec("0.0001") as DecimalValue,
  116:       intervalTolerance: new Dec("0.0001") as DecimalValue,
  117:     },

  352: export async function calculateAuPay(
  353:   request: CalculationRequestV1<AuPayInput>,
  354:   resolution: AuPayResolution,
  355:   context: AuPayContext,
  356: ): Promise<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>> {
  357:   const canonicalRequestHash = await canonicalHash(request);
  358:   const manifestRefs = [
  359:     resolution.incomeTax.manifestRef,
  360:     resolution.medicare.manifestRef,
  361:     resolution.superGuarantee.manifestRef,
  362:     ...(resolution.stsl ? [resolution.stsl.manifestRef] : []),
  363:     ...(resolution.payg ? [resolution.payg.manifestRef] : []),
  364:   ];
  365:   const base = {
  366:     requestId: request.requestId,
  367:     calculationId: `calc_${canonicalRequestHash.slice(0, 16)}`,
  368:     calculatorId: request.calculatorId,
  369:     calculationClass: "B" as const,
  370:     calculatedAt: context.now,
  371:     engineVersions: { [AU_TAX_ENGINE_ID]: AU_TAX_ENGINE_VERSION, E03: "0.1.0", E04: "0.1.0" },
  372:     rulePacks: manifestRefs,
  373:   };
  374:   const finish = async (
  375:     partial: Omit<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>, keyof typeof base | "integrity">,
  376:   ): Promise<CalculationResultV1<AuPayOutput>> => {
  377:     const withoutIntegrity = { ...base, ...partial };
  378:     return {
  379:       ...withoutIntegrity,
  380:       integrity: { canonicalRequestHash, canonicalResultHash: await canonicalHash(withoutIntegrity) },
  381:     };
  382:   };
  383: 
  384:   const parsed = zAuPayInput.safeParse(request.input);
  385:   if (!parsed.success) {
  386:     return finish({
  387:       status: "invalid",
  388:       warnings: [],
  389:       errors: parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
  390:         code: "PC-VAL-0002",
  391:         severity: "error" as const,
  392:         message: issue.message,
  393:         path: issue.path.map(String),
  394:       })),
  395:       assumptions: [],
  396:       sources: [],
  397:     });
  398:   }
  399: 
  400:   try {
  401:     const { output, warnings, trace } = computeAuPay(parsed.data, resolution);
  402: 
  403:     const reconciliation: ReconciliationV1 = buildReconciliation(parsed.data, output);
  404:     if (!reconciliation.passed) {
  405:       return finish({
  406:         status: "failed",
  407:         warnings,
  408:         errors: [
  409:           {
  410:             code: "PC-REC-0002",
  411:             severity: "error",
  412:             message: "Pay reconciliation failed: components do not sum to gross cash income.",
  413:           },
  414:         ],
  415:         assumptions: [],
  416:         sources: [],
  417:         reconciliation: [reconciliation],
  418:       });
  419:     }
  420: 
  421:     const sources: SourceRef[] = manifestRefs.flatMap((ref) => {
  422:       const pack = [
  423:         resolution.incomeTax.pack,
  424:         resolution.medicare.pack,
  425:         resolution.superGuarantee.pack,
  426:         resolution.stsl?.pack,
  427:         resolution.payg?.pack,
  428:       ].find((p) => p?.rulePackId === ref.rulePackId);
  429:       const source = pack?.sources[0];
  430:       return source
  431:         ? [
  432:             {
  433:               sourceId: source.sourceId,

  440:           ]
  441:         : [];
  442:     });
  443: 
  444:     const assumptions: AssumptionRecord[] = buildAssumptions(parsed.data, resolution);
  445:

  447:       status: warnings.some((w) => w.severity === "warning") ? "success_with_warnings" : "success",
  448:       output,
  449:       warnings,
  450:       errors: [],
  451:       assumptions,
  452:       sources,
  453:       ...(request.options.traceLevel !== "none" ? { trace: { level: "full" as const, steps: trace } } : {}),
  454:       reconciliation: [reconciliation],
  455:     });
  456:   } catch (thrown) {
  457:     if (thrown instanceof InvalidPayInputError) {
  458:       return finish({
  459:         status: "invalid",
  460:         warnings: [],

  462:         assumptions: [],
  463:         sources: [],

  471:         assumptions: [],

  473:       });
  474:     }
  475:     throw thrown;
  476:   }

  479: function buildReconciliation(input: AuPayInput, output: AuPayOutput): ReconciliationV1 {
  480:   // net + liability + pre-tax deductions + post-tax deductions must equal
  481:   // gross cash income to the cent (all values already rounded consistently).
  482:   const grossCash = moneyToDecimal(output.annualised.grossCashIncome) as DecimalValue;
  483:   const net = moneyToDecimal(output.netAnnualCash) as DecimalValue;
  484:   const liability = moneyToDecimal(output.liability.totalAnnualLiability) as DecimalValue;
  485:   const preTax = moneyDec(input.adjustments.salarySacrificeSuper).plus(
  486:     moneyDec(input.adjustments.otherPreTaxDeductions),
  487:   ) as DecimalValue;
  488:   const postTax = moneyDec(input.adjustments.postTaxDeductions);
  489:   const reconstructed = net.plus(liability).plus(preTax).plus(postTax) as DecimalValue;
  490:   const difference = reconstructed.minus(grossCash) as DecimalValue;
  491:   return {
  492:     openingAmount: aud(grossCash),
  493:     additions: aud(zero()),
  494:     reductions: aud(liability.plus(preTax).plus(postTax) as DecimalValue),
  495:     closingAmount: aud(net),
  496:     expectedClosingAmount: aud(grossCash.minus(liability).minus(preTax).minus(postTax) as DecimalValue),
  497:     difference: aud(difference),
  498:     tolerance: aud(new Dec("0.02") as DecimalValue),
  499:     passed: difference.abs().lessThanOrEqualTo("0.02"),
  500:   };

### packages/engine-property/src/stamp-duty.ts
    1: import { Dec, dec, type DecimalValue } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
    2: import type { StampDutyRules } from "@paymentcalcs/rules-au";
    3: 
    4: /**
    5:  * E08 â€” general transfer/stamp duty (Â§12.8). Duty = bracket base + rate per
    6:  * $100 (or part thereof) of the value above the bracket bound. Concessions,
    7:  * exemptions, surcharges and first-home schemes are NOT modelled at P0 and
    8:  * the route says so explicitly.
    9:  */
   10: 
   11: export class DutyRulesUnavailableError extends Error {
   12:   readonly code = "PC-RULE-0004";
   13: }
   14: 
   15: export interface DutyComputation {
   16:   duty: DecimalValue;
   17:   bracketOver: string;
   18:   bracketBase: DecimalValue;
   19:   ratePer100: DecimalValue;
   20:   hundredsCounted: DecimalValue;
   21:   minimumApplied: boolean;
   22: }
   23: 
   24: const d = (s: string | number): DecimalValue => new Dec(s) as DecimalValue;
   25: 
   26: export function generalDuty(dutiableValue: DecimalValue, rules: StampDutyRules): DutyComputation {
   27:   if (!rules.general) {
   28:     throw new DutyRulesUnavailableError("This jurisdiction's duty rates are not yet populated.");
   29:   }
   30:   if (dutiableValue.lessThan(0)) {
   31:     throw new RangeError("Dutiable value cannot be negative.");
   32:   }
   33:   const { brackets, minimumDuty } = rules.general;
   34:   let selected = brackets[0]!;
   35:   for (const bracket of brackets) {
   36:     if (dutiableValue.greaterThan(dec(bracket.over))) selected = bracket;
   37:   }
   38:   const excess = (Dec.max(d(0), dutiableValue.minus(dec(selected.over))) as DecimalValue);
   39:   // "$100 or part thereof": any partial hundred counts as a full hundred.
   40:   const hundreds = excess.div(100).toDecimalPlaces(0, Dec.ROUND_UP) as DecimalValue;
   41:   let duty = dec(selected.baseAmount).plus(hundreds.times(dec(selected.ratePer100))) as DecimalValue;
   42:   let minimumApplied = false;
   43:   if (minimumDuty !== null && duty.lessThan(dec(minimumDuty))) {
   44:     duty = dec(minimumDuty) as DecimalValue;
   45:     minimumApplied = true;
   46:   }
   47:   return {
   48:     duty: duty.toDecimalPlaces(2, Dec.ROUND_HALF_UP) as DecimalValue,
   49:     bracketOver: selected.over,
   50:     bracketBase: dec(selected.baseAmount) as DecimalValue,
   51:     ratePer100: dec(selected.ratePer100) as DecimalValue,
   52:     hundredsCounted: hundreds,
   53:     minimumApplied,
   54:   };
   55: }

   18: 
   19: const PERIODS_PER_YEAR: Record<LoanFrequencyKind, number> = {
   20:   weekly: 52,
   21:   fortnightly: 26,
   22:   monthly: 12,
   23: };

   25: export function frequencyOf(kind: LoanFrequencyKind): Frequency {
   26:   return kind === "monthly" ? { kind: "monthly" } : { kind };

   28: 
   29: /** Â§13.5 closed-form payment; Â§13.6 with a residual balloon. */
   30: export function amortisingPayment(
   31:   principal: DecimalValue,
   32:   periodicRate: DecimalValue,
   33:   periods: number,
   34:   balloon: DecimalValue = new Dec(0) as DecimalValue,
   35: ): DecimalValue {
   36:   if (periods <= 0) return principal;
   37:   if (periodicRate.isZero()) {
   38:     return principal.minus(balloon).div(periods) as DecimalValue;
   39:   }
   40:   const onePlus = new Dec(1).plus(periodicRate);
   41:   const discounted = balloon.div(onePlus.pow(periods));
   42:   const numerator = principal.minus(discounted).times(periodicRate);
   43:   const denominator = new Dec(1).minus(onePlus.pow(-periods));
   44:   return numerator.div(denominator) as DecimalValue;
   45: }

   99: /** Â§13.7 recurrence with per-period cent rounding and final-payment adjustment. */
  100: export function buildLoanSchedule(input: LoanScheduleInput): LoanScheduleResult {
  101:   const zero = new Dec(0) as DecimalValue;
  102:   const periodicRate = input.annualRate.div(PERIODS_PER_YEAR[input.frequency]) as DecimalValue;
  103:   const ioPeriods =
  104:     input.repaymentType === "interest_only"
  105:       ? (input.interestOnlyPeriods ?? input.termPeriods)
  106:       : (input.interestOnlyPeriods ?? 0);
  107:   const amortPeriods = input.termPeriods - ioPeriods;
  108:   const balloon = input.balloon ?? zero;
  109: 
  110:   const scheduledPayment =
  111:     input.paymentOverride ??
  112:     (amortPeriods > 0
  113:       ? cents(amortisingPayment(input.principal, periodicRate, amortPeriods, balloon))
  114:       : cents(input.principal.times(periodicRate) as DecimalValue));
  115: 
  116:   const start = plainDate(input.firstPaymentDate);
  117:   const freq = frequencyOf(input.frequency);
  118:   const rows: LoanScheduleRow[] = [];
  119:   let balance = input.principal;
  120:   let totalInterest = zero;
  121:   let totalFees = zero;
  122:   let totalPaid = zero;
  123:   let negativeAmortisation = false;
  124:   let payoffDate: ISODate | null = null;
  125:   const maxPeriods = input.termPeriods + 600; // guard runaway non-amortising loops
  126: 
  127:   for (let k = 1; k <= maxPeriods && balance.greaterThan("0.004"); k += 1) {
  128:     const inIo = k <= ioPeriods;
  129:     const interest = cents(balance.times(periodicRate) as DecimalValue);
  130:     const fee = cents(input.periodicFee ?? zero);
  131:     let extra = inIo ? zero : cents(input.extraPerPeriod ?? zero);
  132:     const isFinalScheduled = k === input.termPeriods;
  133: 
  134:     let payment: DecimalValue;
  135:     let last = false;
  136:     if (inIo) {
  137:       payment = interest;
  138:     } else if (isFinalScheduled) {
  139:       // Final-payment adjustment covers accumulated rounding and the balloon
  140:       // (Â§13.5). It must never silently clear a non-amortising balance, so the
  141:       // clearing payment is capped at one extra scheduled payment beyond the
  142:       // balloon; anything larger is reported as unresolved.
  143:       const required = cents(balance.plus(interest) as DecimalValue);
  144:       const clearingCap = scheduledPayment.times(2).plus(balloon) as DecimalValue;
  145:       if (required.lessThanOrEqualTo(clearingCap)) {
  146:         payment = required;
  147:         extra = zero;
  148:         last = true;
  149:       } else {
  150:         payment = scheduledPayment;
  151:       }
  152:     } else {
  153:       payment = scheduledPayment;
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     // Never overpay: cap payment + extra at balance + interest.
  157:     const owed = balance.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  158:     if (payment.plus(extra).greaterThan(owed)) {
  159:       payment = (Dec.min(payment, owed) as DecimalValue);
  160:       extra = (Dec.min(extra, owed.minus(payment) as DecimalValue) as DecimalValue);
  161:       last = true;
  162:     }
  163: 
  164:     if (!inIo && !last && payment.lessThan(interest)) negativeAmortisation = true;
  165: 
  166:     const principalPart = payment.plus(extra).minus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  167:     balance = cents(balance.minus(principalPart) as DecimalValue);
  168:     if (balance.abs().lessThan("0.005")) balance = zero;
  169:     totalInterest = totalInterest.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  170:     totalFees = totalFees.plus(fee) as DecimalValue;
  171:     totalPaid = totalPaid.plus(payment).plus(extra).plus(fee) as DecimalValue;
  172:     const date = isoDate(nthOccurrence(start, freq, k - 1));
  173:     rows.push({
  174:       period: k,
  175:       date,
  176:       payment,
  177:       interest,
  178:       principal: principalPart,
  179:       extraPayment: extra,
  180:       fees: fee,
  181:       closingBalance: balance,
  182:     });
  183:     if (balance.isZero() && payoffDate === null) payoffDate = date;
  184:     if (last) break;
  185:     if (k >= input.termPeriods) break; // past contractual term: report unresolved
  186:   }
  187: 
  188:   const closing = rows.length > 0 ? rows[rows.length - 1]!.closingBalance : input.principal;
  189:   const totalPrincipalPaid = rows.reduce(
  190:     (acc, row) => acc.plus(row.principal) as DecimalValue,
  191:     zero,
  192:   );
  193:   const difference = input.principal.minus(totalPrincipalPaid).minus(closing) as DecimalValue;
  194: 
  195:   return {
  196:     rows,
  197:     scheduledPayment,
  198:     totalInterest: cents(totalInterest),
  199:     totalPrincipal: cents(totalPrincipalPaid),
  200:     totalFees: cents(totalFees),
  201:     totalPaid: cents(totalPaid),
  202:     payoffDate,
  203:     negativeAmortisation,
  204:     unresolvedBalance: closing.greaterThan("0.004") ? closing : null,
  205:     reconciliation: {
  206:       opening: input.principal,
  207:       totalPrincipalPaid: cents(totalPrincipalPaid),
  208:       closing,
  209:       difference: cents(difference),
  210:       passed: difference.abs().lessThanOrEqualTo("0.02"),
  211:     },
  212:   };
  213: }
### packages/engine-savings/src/savings.ts
    1: import { Dec, type DecimalValue } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
    2: 
    3: /**
    4:  * E14 â€” deposit growth and target solving (Â§13.11, Â§12.13). Closed forms for
    5:  * constant settings; the yearly schedule is produced by period simulation so

   10: export type ContributionTiming = "end" | "beginning";
   11: 
   12: const PERIODS: Record<CompoundingFrequency, number> = { monthly: 12, quarterly: 4, annually: 1 };
   13: const cents = (v: DecimalValue): DecimalValue => v.toDecimalPlaces(2, Dec.ROUND_HALF_UP) as DecimalValue;
   14: const d = (s: string | number): DecimalValue => new Dec(s) as DecimalValue;

   16: export interface SavingsInput {
   17:   openingBalance: string;

   26: export interface SavingsYearRow {
   27:   year: number;

   29:   interest: DecimalValue;

   31: }
   32: 
   33: export interface SavingsResult {
   34:   futureValue: DecimalValue;
   35:   totalContributions: DecimalValue;

   42: 
   43: /** Â§13.11 closed form. */
   44: export function futureValueClosedForm(input: SavingsInput): DecimalValue {
   45:   const periods = PERIODS[input.compounding] * input.years;
   46:   const i = d(input.annualRate).div(PERIODS[input.compounding]) as DecimalValue;
   47:   const p = d(input.openingBalance);
   48:   const c = d(input.contribution);
   49:   if (i.isZero()) return p.plus(c.times(periods)) as DecimalValue;
   50:   const growth = new Dec(1).plus(i).pow(periods) as DecimalValue;
   51:   let contributionTerm = c.times(growth.minus(1).div(i)) as DecimalValue;
   52:   if (input.timing === "beginning") contributionTerm = contributionTerm.times(new Dec(1).plus(i)) as DecimalValue;
   53:   return p.times(growth).plus(contributionTerm) as DecimalValue;
   54: }
   55: 
   56: export function simulateSavings(input: SavingsInput): SavingsResult {
   57:   const ppy = PERIODS[input.compounding];
   58:   const i = d(input.annualRate).div(ppy) as DecimalValue;
   59:   let balance = d(input.openingBalance);
   60:   let totalContributions = d(0);
   61:   let totalInterest = d(0);
   62:   const years: SavingsYearRow[] = [];
   63: 
   64:   for (let year = 1; year <= input.years; year += 1) {
   65:     let yearContributions = d(0);
   66:     let yearInterest = d(0);
   67:     for (let k = 0; k < ppy; k += 1) {
   68:       if (input.timing === "beginning") {
   69:         balance = balance.plus(d(input.contribution)) as DecimalValue;
   70:         yearContributions = yearContributions.plus(d(input.contribution)) as DecimalValue;
   71:       }
   72:       const interest = cents(balance.times(i) as DecimalValue);
   73:       balance = balance.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
   74:       yearInterest = yearInterest.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
   75:       if (input.timing === "end") {
   76:         balance = balance.plus(d(input.contribution)) as DecimalValue;
   77:         yearContributions = yearContributions.plus(d(input.contribution)) as DecimalValue;
   78:       }
   79:     }
   80:     totalContributions = totalContributions.plus(yearContributions) as DecimalValue;
   81:     totalInterest = totalInterest.plus(yearInterest) as DecimalValue;
   82:     years.push({
   83:       year,
   84:       contributions: cents(yearContributions),
   85:       interest: cents(yearInterest),
   86:       closingBalance: cents(balance),
   87:     });
   88:   }
   89: 
   90:   const closedForm = futureValueClosedForm(input);
   91:   const futureValue = cents(balance);
   92:   // Per-period cent rounding causes drift vs the exact closed form; tolerance
   93:   // scales with the number of periods (â‰¤ half a cent per period).
   94:   const tolerance = d(0.01).times(ppy * input.years + 1) as DecimalValue;
   95:   return {
   96:     futureValue,
   97:     totalContributions: cents(totalContributions),
   98:     totalInterest: cents(totalInterest),
   99:     years,
  100:     closedFormValue: cents(closedForm),
  101:     reconciliationPassed: futureValue.minus(closedForm).abs().lessThanOrEqualTo(tolerance),
  102:   };
  103: }
  104: 
  105: /** Savings goal: required per-period contribution for a target (Â§12.13). */
  106: export function requiredContribution(
  107:   target: string,
  108:   input: Omit<SavingsInput, "contribution">,
  109: ): DecimalValue {
  110:   const periods = PERIODS[input.compounding] * input.years;
  111:   const i = d(input.annualRate).div(PERIODS[input.compounding]) as DecimalValue;
  112:   const p = d(input.openingBalance);
  113:   const t = d(target);
  114:   if (periods <= 0) return d(0);
  115:   if (i.isZero()) {
  116:     return (Dec.max(d(0), t.minus(p).div(periods)) as DecimalValue);
  117:   }
  118:   const growth = new Dec(1).plus(i).pow(periods) as DecimalValue;
  119:   let annuity = growth.minus(1).div(i) as DecimalValue;
  120:   if (input.timing === "beginning") annuity = annuity.times(new Dec(1).plus(i)) as DecimalValue;
  121:   const needed = t.minus(p.times(growth)).div(annuity) as DecimalValue;
  122:   return (Dec.max(d(0), needed) as DecimalValue);
  123: }

   72:     const promoActive =
   73:       input.promotionalRate !== undefined &&
   74:       input.promotionalEndDate !== undefined &&
   75:       date < input.promotionalEndDate;
   76:     const annualRate = promoActive ? input.promotionalRate! : input.annualPurchaseRate;
   77:     const monthlyRate = d(annualRate).div(12) as DecimalValue;
   78: 
   79:     const opening = balance;
   80:     const spending = cents(d(input.newSpendingPerMonth ?? "0"));
   81:     const interest = cents(opening.times(monthlyRate) as DecimalValue);
   82:     const fee = cents(d(input.monthlyFee ?? "0"));
   83:     balance = balance.plus(spending).plus(interest).plus(fee) as DecimalValue;
   84: 
   85:     const minimum = cents(
   86:       (Dec.max(balance.times(d(input.minimumPercent)), d(input.minimumFloor)) as DecimalValue),
   87:     );
   88:     if (firstMinimum === null) firstMinimum = (Dec.min(minimum, balance) as DecimalValue);
   89: 
   90:     let payment =
   91:       input.strategy === "fixed_payment" && input.fixedPayment
   92:         ? (Dec.max(d(input.fixedPayment), minimum) as DecimalValue)
   93:         : minimum;
   94:     payment = (Dec.min(payment, balance) as DecimalValue);
   95: 
   96:     if (payment.lessThanOrEqualTo(interest.plus(fee).plus(spending))) nonAmortising = true;
   97: 
   98:     const closing = cents(balance.minus(payment) as DecimalValue);
   99:     const reconstructed = opening.plus(spending).plus(interest).plus(fee).minus(payment);
  100:     if (reconstructed.minus(closing).abs().greaterThan("0.011")) reconciliationPassed = false;
  101: 
  102:     balance = closing.abs().lessThan("0.005") ? zero : closing;
  103:     totalInterest = totalInterest.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  104:     totalFees = totalFees.plus(fee) as DecimalValue;
  105:     totalPaid = totalPaid.plus(payment) as DecimalValue;
  106: 
  107:     cycles.push({
  108:       cycle: k,
  109:       date,
  110:       rateApplied: annualRate,
  111:       interest,
  112:       fee,
  113:       spending,
  114:       minimumPayment: minimum,
  115:       payment,
  116:       closingBalance: balance,
  117:     });
  118:     if (balance.isZero()) {
  119:       payoffDate = date;
  120:       break;
  121:     }
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   return {
  125:     cycles,
  126:     payoffDate,
  127:     totalInterest: cents(totalInterest),
  128:     totalFees: cents(totalFees),
  129:     totalPaid: cents(totalPaid),
  130:     firstMinimumPayment: cents(firstMinimum ?? zero),
  131:     monthsToPayoff: payoffDate ? cycles.length : null,
  132:     nonAmortising,
  133:     reconciliationPassed,
  134:   };
  135: }
### packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/ledger.ts
    1: import {
    2:   Dec,
    3:   compareDates,
    4:   isoDate,
    5:   nthOccurrence,
    6:   plainDate,
    7:   type DecimalValue,
    8:   type ISODate,
    9: } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
   10: import { amortisingPayment, frequencyOf, type LoanFrequencyKind } from "@paymentcalcs/engine-loans";
   11: 
   12: /**
   13:  * E07 â€” scheduled mortgage ledger (Merge Record #3): a payment-period ledger
   14:  * with dated and recurring events. Daily accrual is NOT modelled at P0; the
   15:  * contracts carry day-count fields so a daily mode can be added without
   16:  * breaking changes. Interest per period accrues on
   17:  * max(0, balance âˆ’ offset Ã— effectiveness) (Â§13.9), floored at zero.
   18:  */
   19: 
   20: export type LedgerEvent =
   21:   | { type: "rate_change"; effectiveDate: ISODate; annualRate: string }
   22:   | { type: "extra_recurring"; startDate: ISODate; endDate?: ISODate; amount: string }
   23:   | { type: "extra_oneoff"; effectiveDate: ISODate; amount: string }
   24:   | { type: "offset_deposit_recurring"; startDate: ISODate; endDate?: ISODate; amount: string }
   25:   | { type: "offset_deposit"; effectiveDate: ISODate; amount: string }
   26:   | { type: "offset_withdrawal"; effectiveDate: ISODate; amount: string }
   27:   | { type: "fee_annual"; startDate: ISODate; amount: string; financed: boolean }
   28:   | { type: "fee_oneoff"; effectiveDate: ISODate; amount: string; financed: boolean };
   29: 
   30: export interface LedgerInput {
   31:   openingPrincipal: string;
   32:   annualRate: string;
   33:   termPeriods: number;
   34:   repaymentFrequency: LoanFrequencyKind;
   35:   firstRepaymentDate: ISODate;
   36:   repaymentType: "principal_and_interest" | "interest_only";
   37:   interestOnlyPeriods?: number;
   38:   repaymentResetPolicy: "keep_amount" | "recalculate_to_term";
   39:   offsetOpeningBalance?: string;
   40:   /** 1 = 100% offset. Contract assumption, surfaced in Advanced mode. */
   41:   offsetEffectiveness?: string;
   42:   paymentOverride?: string;
   43:   events?: LedgerEvent[];
   44: }
   45: 
   46: export interface LedgerRow {
   47:   period: number;
   48:   date: ISODate;
   49:   annualRate: string;
   50:   interest: DecimalValue;
   51:   payment: DecimalValue;
   52:   extraPayment: DecimalValue;
   53:   fees: DecimalValue;
   54:   offsetBalance: DecimalValue;
   55:   closingBalance: DecimalValue;
   56: }
   57: 
   58: export interface LedgerResult {
   59:   badge: "scheduled_model";
   60:   rows: LedgerRow[];
   61:   scheduledPaymentInitial: DecimalValue;
   62:   totalInterest: DecimalValue;
   63:   totalFees: DecimalValue;
   64:   totalPaid: DecimalValue;
   65:   payoffDate: ISODate | null;
   66:   periodsUsed: number;
   67:   unresolvedBalance: DecimalValue | null;
   68:   negativeAmortisation: boolean;
   69:   finalOffsetBalance: DecimalValue;
   70:   reconciliation: {
   71:     opening: DecimalValue;
   72:     interestCharged: DecimalValue;
   73:     financedFees: DecimalValue;
   74:     principalPaid: DecimalValue;
   75:     closing: DecimalValue;
   76:     difference: DecimalValue;
   77:     passed: boolean;
   78:   };
   79: }
   80: 
   81: const PPY: Record<LoanFrequencyKind, number> = { weekly: 52, fortnightly: 26, monthly: 12 };
   82: const cents = (v: DecimalValue): DecimalValue => v.toDecimalPlaces(2, Dec.ROUND_HALF_UP) as DecimalValue;
   83: const d = (s: string | number): DecimalValue => new Dec(s) as DecimalValue;
   84: 
   85: export function runLedger(input: LedgerInput): LedgerResult {
   86:   const zero = d(0);
   87:   const freq = frequencyOf(input.repaymentFrequency);
   88:   const start = plainDate(input.firstRepaymentDate);
   89:   const ppy = PPY[input.repaymentFrequency];
   90:   const events = input.events ?? [];
   91:   const effectiveness = d(input.offsetEffectiveness ?? "1");
   92:   const ioPeriods =
   93:     input.repaymentType === "interest_only"
   94:       ? (input.interestOnlyPeriods ?? input.termPeriods)
   95:       : (input.interestOnlyPeriods ?? 0);
   96: 
   97:   // Sorted dated occurrences per event stream, expanded for recurrences.
   98:   interface Occurrence {
   99:     date: ISODate;
  100:     order: number; // Â§11.5-inspired intra-period order
  101:     apply: (state: State) => void;
  102:   }
  103:   interface State {
  104:     balance: DecimalValue;
  105:     offset: DecimalValue;
  106:     rate: DecimalValue;
  107:     payment: DecimalValue;
  108:     rateChanged: boolean;
  109:     cashFees: DecimalValue;
  110:     financedFees: DecimalValue;
  111:     /** One-off extra repayments due this period (join the payment path so the
  112:      * Â§12.5.8 cash-flow invariant holds). */
  113:     pendingExtra: DecimalValue;
  114:   }
  115: 
  116:   const horizon = nthOccurrence(start, freq, input.termPeriods + 599);
  117:   const occurrences: Occurrence[] = [];
  118:   const pushRecurring = (
  119:     startDate: ISODate,
  120:     endDate: ISODate | undefined,
  121:     recurFreq: Parameters<typeof nthOccurrence>[1],
  122:     order: number,
  123:     apply: Occurrence["apply"],
  124:   ) => {
  125:     const s = plainDate(startDate);
  126:     const e = endDate ? plainDate(endDate) : horizon;
  127:     for (let k = 0; ; k += 1) {
  128:       const date = nthOccurrence(s, recurFreq, k);
  129:       if (compareDates(date, e) > 0 || compareDates(date, horizon) > 0) break;
  130:       occurrences.push({ date: isoDate(date), order, apply });
  131:       if (k > 5000) break;
  132:     }
  133:   };
  134: 
  135:   for (const event of events) {
  136:     switch (event.type) {
  137:       case "rate_change":
  138:         occurrences.push({
  139:           date: event.effectiveDate,
  140:           order: 1,
  141:           apply: (s) => {
  142:             s.rate = d(event.annualRate);
  143:             s.rateChanged = true;
  144:           },
  145:         });
  146:         break;
  147:       case "offset_deposit":
  148:         occurrences.push({ date: event.effectiveDate, order: 2, apply: (s) => void (s.offset = s.offset.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue) });
  149:         break;
  150:       case "offset_withdrawal":
  151:         occurrences.push({
  152:           date: event.effectiveDate,
  153:           order: 2,
  154:           apply: (s) => void (s.offset = (Dec.max(zero, s.offset.minus(d(event.amount))) as DecimalValue)),
  155:         });
  156:         break;
  157:       case "offset_deposit_recurring":
  158:         pushRecurring(event.startDate, event.endDate, freq, 2, (s) => void (s.offset = s.offset.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue));
  159:         break;
  160:       case "extra_oneoff":
  161:         occurrences.push({
  162:           date: event.effectiveDate,
  163:           order: 4,
  164:           apply: (s) => void (s.pendingExtra = s.pendingExtra.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue),
  165:         });
  166:         break;
  167:       case "fee_oneoff":
  168:         occurrences.push({
  169:           date: event.effectiveDate,
  170:           order: 5,
  171:           apply: (s) => {
  172:             if (event.financed) s.financedFees = s.financedFees.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue;
  173:             else s.cashFees = s.cashFees.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue;
  174:           },
  175:         });
  176:         break;
  177:       case "fee_annual":
  178:         pushRecurring(event.startDate, undefined, { kind: "annually" }, 5, (s) => {
  179:           if (event.financed) s.financedFees = s.financedFees.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue;
  180:           else s.cashFees = s.cashFees.plus(d(event.amount)) as DecimalValue;
  181:         });
  182:         break;
  183:       case "extra_recurring":
  184:         // handled per-period below (aligned to repayment periods, MORT-AC-003)
  185:         break;
  186:     }
  187:   }
  188:   occurrences.sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : a.order - b.order));
  189: 
  190:   const extraRecurring = events.filter((e): e is Extract<LedgerEvent, { type: "extra_recurring" }> => e.type === "extra_recurring");
  191: 
  192:   const opening = d(input.openingPrincipal);
  193:   const initialPayment =
  194:     input.paymentOverride !== undefined
  195:       ? d(input.paymentOverride)
  196:       : ioPeriods >= input.termPeriods
  197:         ? cents(opening.times(d(input.annualRate).div(ppy)) as DecimalValue)
  198:         : cents(amortisingPayment(opening, d(input.annualRate).div(ppy) as DecimalValue, input.termPeriods - ioPeriods));
  199: 
  200:   const state: State = {
  201:     balance: opening,
  202:     offset: d(input.offsetOpeningBalance ?? "0"),
  203:     rate: d(input.annualRate),
  204:     payment: initialPayment,
  205:     rateChanged: false,
  206:     cashFees: zero,
  207:     financedFees: zero,
  208:     pendingExtra: zero,
  209:   };
  210: 
  211:   const rows: LedgerRow[] = [];
  212:   let occurrenceIndex = 0;
  213:   let totalInterest = zero;
  214:   let totalFees = zero;
  215:   let totalPaid = zero;
  216:   let financedFeesTotal = zero;
  217:   let principalPaid = zero;
  218:   let payoffDate: ISODate | null = null;
  219:   let negativeAmortisation = false;
  220:   const maxPeriods = input.termPeriods + 600;
  221: 
  222:   for (let k = 1; k <= maxPeriods && state.balance.greaterThan("0.004"); k += 1) {
  223:     const periodDate = isoDate(nthOccurrence(start, freq, k - 1));
  224:     state.cashFees = zero;
  225:     state.financedFees = zero;
  226:     state.rateChanged = false;
  227: 
  228:     // Apply dated occurrences due on or before this period date (Â§11.5 order).
  229:     while (occurrenceIndex < occurrences.length && occurrences[occurrenceIndex]!.date <= periodDate) {
  230:       occurrences[occurrenceIndex]!.apply(state);
  231:       occurrenceIndex += 1;
  232:     }
  233: 
  234:     const inIo = k <= ioPeriods;
  235:     const remaining = input.termPeriods - k + 1;
  236:     if ((state.rateChanged || k === ioPeriods + 1) && !inIo) {
  237:       if (input.repaymentResetPolicy === "recalculate_to_term" || k === ioPeriods + 1) {
  238:         if (input.paymentOverride === undefined) {
  239:           state.payment = cents(
  240:             amortisingPayment(state.balance, state.rate.div(ppy) as DecimalValue, Math.max(1, remaining)),
  241:           );
  242:         }
  243:       }
  244:     }
  245: 
  246:     // Financed fees capitalise before interest accrues this period.
  247:     state.balance = state.balance.plus(state.financedFees) as DecimalValue;
  248:     financedFeesTotal = financedFeesTotal.plus(state.financedFees) as DecimalValue;
  249: 
  250:     const interestBase = (Dec.max(zero, state.balance.minus(state.offset.times(effectiveness))) as DecimalValue);
  251:     const interest = cents(interestBase.times(state.rate.div(ppy)) as DecimalValue);
  252: 
  253:     let payment = inIo ? interest : state.payment;
  254:     let extra = state.pendingExtra;
  255:     state.pendingExtra = zero;
  256:     for (const recurring of extraRecurring) {
  257:       if (periodDate >= recurring.startDate && (!recurring.endDate || periodDate <= recurring.endDate) && !inIo) {
  258:         extra = extra.plus(d(recurring.amount)) as DecimalValue;
  259:       }
  260:     }
  261: 
  262:     const owed = state.balance.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  263:     let last = false;
  264:     if (payment.plus(extra).greaterThanOrEqualTo(owed)) {
  265:       payment = (Dec.min(payment, owed) as DecimalValue);
  266:       extra = (Dec.min(extra, owed.minus(payment) as DecimalValue) as DecimalValue);
  267:       last = true;
  268:     } else if (k === input.termPeriods) {
  269:       const required = cents(owed);
  270:       const clearingCap = state.payment.times(2) as DecimalValue;
  271:       if (required.lessThanOrEqualTo(clearingCap)) {
  272:         payment = required;
  273:         extra = zero;
  274:         last = true;
  275:       }
  276:     }
  277: 
  278:     if (!inIo && !last && payment.lessThan(interest)) negativeAmortisation = true;
  279: 
  280:     const principalPart = payment.plus(extra).minus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  281:     state.balance = cents(state.balance.minus(principalPart) as DecimalValue);
  282:     if (state.balance.abs().lessThan("0.005")) state.balance = zero;
  283: 
  284:     totalInterest = totalInterest.plus(interest) as DecimalValue;
  285:     const periodFees = state.cashFees.plus(state.financedFees) as DecimalValue;
  286:     totalFees = totalFees.plus(periodFees) as DecimalValue;
  287:     totalPaid = totalPaid.plus(payment).plus(extra).plus(state.cashFees) as DecimalValue;
  288:     principalPaid = principalPaid.plus(principalPart) as DecimalValue;
  289: 
  290:     rows.push({
  291:       period: k,
  292:       date: periodDate,
  293:       annualRate: state.rate.toString(),
  294:       interest,
  295:       payment,
  296:       extraPayment: extra,
  297:       fees: periodFees,
  298:       offsetBalance: state.offset,
  299:       closingBalance: state.balance,
  300:     });
  301:     if (state.balance.isZero() && payoffDate === null) payoffDate = periodDate;
  302:     if (last) break;
  303:     if (k >= input.termPeriods) break;
  304:   }
  305: 
  306:   const closing = rows.length > 0 ? rows[rows.length - 1]!.closingBalance : opening;
  307:   // Â§12.5.8: opening + financed fees + interest âˆ’ payments âˆ’ extras = closing.
  308:   const reconstructed = opening
  309:     .plus(financedFeesTotal)
  310:     .minus(principalPaid) as DecimalValue;
  311:   const difference = reconstructed.minus(closing) as DecimalValue;
  312: 
  313:   return {
  314:     badge: "scheduled_model",
  315:     rows,
  316:     scheduledPaymentInitial: initialPayment,
  317:     totalInterest: cents(totalInterest),
  318:     totalFees: cents(totalFees),
  319:     totalPaid: cents(totalPaid),
  320:     payoffDate,
  321:     periodsUsed: rows.length,
  322:     unresolvedBalance: closing.greaterThan("0.004") ? closing : null,
  323:     negativeAmortisation,
  324:     finalOffsetBalance: rows.length > 0 ? rows[rows.length - 1]!.offsetBalance : d(input.offsetOpeningBalance ?? "0"),
  325:     reconciliation: {
  326:       opening,
  327:       interestCharged: cents(totalInterest),
  328:       financedFees: cents(financedFeesTotal),
  329:       principalPaid: cents(principalPaid),
  330:       closing,
  331:       difference: cents(difference),
  332:       passed: difference.abs().lessThanOrEqualTo("0.05"),
  333:     },
  334:   };
  335: }
  336: 
  337: /** Interest and time saved versus a baseline without offsets/extras. */
  338: export function compareToBaseline(input: LedgerInput): {
  339:   scenario: LedgerResult;
  340:   baseline: LedgerResult;
  341:   interestSaved: DecimalValue;
  342:   periodsSaved: number;
  343: } {
  344:   const scenario = runLedger(input);
  345:   const baseline = runLedger({
  346:     ...input,
  347:     offsetOpeningBalance: "0",
  348:     events: (input.events ?? []).filter(
  349:       (e) =>
  350:         e.type !== "extra_recurring" &&
  351:         e.type !== "extra_oneoff" &&
  352:         e.type !== "offset_deposit" &&
  353:         e.type !== "offset_deposit_recurring" &&
  354:         e.type !== "offset_withdrawal",
  355:     ),
  356:   });
  357:   return {
  358:     scenario,
  359:     baseline,
  360:     interestSaved: baseline.totalInterest.minus(scenario.totalInterest) as DecimalValue,
  361:     periodsSaved: baseline.periodsUsed - scenario.periodsUsed,
  362:   };
  363: }
### packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/refinance.ts
    1: import { Dec, type DecimalValue, type ISODate } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
    2: import { runLedger, type LedgerInput, type LedgerResult } from "./ledger";
    3: 
    4: /**
    5:  * AU-HOME-012 (Â§12.7, Â§13.10): cumulative-cash-flow refinance comparison.
    6:  * Scenarios are compared at a common horizon with residual balances included;
    7:  * comparing monthly repayments alone is prohibited by the PRD.
    8:  */
    9: 
   10: export interface RefinanceCosts {
   11:   /** Paid in cash at switch (discharge, establishment, legal, valuationâ€¦). */
   12:   upfrontCash: string;
   13:   /** Costs added to the new loan principal (accrue interest, Â§12.7 AC). */
   14:   financedCosts: string;
   15:   /** Cashback received; applied at its received date, never earlier. */
   16:   cashback: string;
   17:   cashbackDate?: ISODate;
   18:   /** Ongoing annual fee difference is modelled via each loan's fee events. */
   19: }
   20: 
   21: export interface RefinanceComparison {
   22:   oldLoan: LedgerResult;
   23:   newLoan: LedgerResult;
   24:   repaymentDifference: DecimalValue;
   25:   upfrontNetSwitchingCost: DecimalValue;
   26:   /** Cumulative net cash advantage of switching, by period date. */
   27:   cumulativeDelta: Array<{ date: ISODate; delta: DecimalValue }>;
   28:   /** First crossing where the advantage stays non-negative (Â§13.10). */
   29:   breakEvenDate: ISODate | null;
   30:   /** Later reversals after the first sustainable crossing (disclosed). */
   31:   reversalsAfterBreakEven: number;
   32:   /** Economic cost difference at the common horizon incl. residual balances. */
   33:   horizonDate: ISODate | null;
   34:   economicAdvantageAtHorizon: DecimalValue;
   35: }
   36: 
   37: const d = (s: string | number): DecimalValue => new Dec(s) as DecimalValue;
   38: 
   39: export function compareRefinance(
   40:   oldInput: LedgerInput,
   41:   newInputBase: LedgerInput,
   42:   costs: RefinanceCosts,
   43: ): RefinanceComparison {
   44:   const financed = d(costs.financedCosts);
   45:   const newInput: LedgerInput = {
   46:     ...newInputBase,
   47:     openingPrincipal: d(newInputBase.openingPrincipal).plus(financed).toFixed(2),
   48:   };
   49: 
   50:   const oldLoan = runLedger(oldInput);
   51:   const newLoan = runLedger(newInput);
   52: 
   53:   const horizon = Math.min(oldLoan.rows.length, newLoan.rows.length);
   54:   const upfront = d(costs.upfrontCash);
   55:   const cashback = d(costs.cashback);
   56: 
   57:   const cumulativeDelta: Array<{ date: ISODate; delta: DecimalValue }> = [];
   58:   let oldCum = d(0);
   59:   let newCum = upfront; // cash paid at switch counts against the new scenario
   60:   let cashbackApplied = false;
   61: 
   62:   for (let i = 0; i < horizon; i += 1) {
   63:     const oldRow = oldLoan.rows[i]!;
   64:     const newRow = newLoan.rows[i]!;
   65:     oldCum = oldCum.plus(oldRow.payment).plus(oldRow.extraPayment).plus(oldRow.fees) as DecimalValue;
   66:     newCum = newCum.plus(newRow.payment).plus(newRow.extraPayment).plus(newRow.fees) as DecimalValue;
   67:     if (!cashbackApplied && (!costs.cashbackDate || newRow.date >= costs.cashbackDate)) {
   68:       newCum = newCum.minus(cashback) as DecimalValue;
   69:       cashbackApplied = true;
   70:     }
   71:     // Residual balances make the comparison economic, not cash-flow-only.
   72:     const delta = oldCum
   73:       .plus(oldRow.closingBalance)
   74:       .minus(newCum)
   75:       .minus(newRow.closingBalance) as DecimalValue;
   76:     cumulativeDelta.push({ date: newRow.date, delta });
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   // Â§13.10: the primary break-even is the first crossing that stays
   80:   // non-negative; earlier temporary crossings are disclosed as reversals.
   81:   let breakEvenDate: ISODate | null = null;
   82:   let reversals = 0;
   83:   let allNonNegativeAfter = true;
   84:   const sustainable: boolean[] = new Array(cumulativeDelta.length).fill(false);
   85:   for (let i = cumulativeDelta.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   86:     allNonNegativeAfter = allNonNegativeAfter && cumulativeDelta[i]!.delta.greaterThanOrEqualTo(0);
   87:     sustainable[i] = allNonNegativeAfter;
   88:   }
   89:   let inRun = false;
   90:   for (let i = 0; i < cumulativeDelta.length; i += 1) {
   91:     const nonNegative = cumulativeDelta[i]!.delta.greaterThanOrEqualTo(0);
   92:     if (sustainable[i]) {
   93:       breakEvenDate = cumulativeDelta[i]!.date;
   94:       break;
   95:     }
   96:     if (nonNegative && !inRun) reversals += 1; // a temporary crossing began
   97:     inRun = nonNegative;
   98:   }
   99: 
  100:   const lastDelta = cumulativeDelta.length > 0 ? cumulativeDelta[cumulativeDelta.length - 1]! : null;
  101: 
  102:   return {
  103:     oldLoan,
  104:     newLoan,
  105:     repaymentDifference: oldLoan.scheduledPaymentInitial.minus(newLoan.scheduledPaymentInitial) as DecimalValue,
  106:     upfrontNetSwitchingCost: upfront.plus(financed).minus(cashback) as DecimalValue,
  107:     cumulativeDelta,
  108:     breakEvenDate,
  109:     reversalsAfterBreakEven: reversals,
  110:     horizonDate: lastDelta?.date ?? null,
  111:     economicAdvantageAtHorizon: lastDelta?.delta ?? d(0),
  112:   };
  113: }

 1514:

 2069: - monthly;
 2070: - quarterly;
 2071: - half-yearly;
 2072: - annual;
 2073: - custom interval where engine support exists;
 2074: - business-day adjustment policy.
 2075: 
 2076: ### 12.5.4 Offset Rules
 2077: 
 2078: The engine MUST support:
 2079: 
 2080: - one or more offset accounts;
 2081: - mapping offsets to specified components;
 2082: - 100% and partial offset effectiveness;
 2083: - floor at zero effective principal unless contract permits otherwise;
 2084: - balance events and recurring cash flows;
 2085: - separate account balance and loan balance;
 2086: - no assumption that offset contributions are principal repayments;
 2087: - optional salary-in/expenses-out cash-flow pattern;
 2088: - explicit treatment of offset account fees.
 2089: 
 2090: Daily interest base example:
 2091: 
 2092: ```text
 2093: effective interest balance = max(0, principal balance - eligible offset balance Ã— offset effectiveness)
 2094: ```
 2095: 
 2096: This is a configurable contract assumption, not a universal legal rule.
 2097: 
 2098: ### 12.5.5 Property Layer
 2099: 
 2100: Optional property inputs:
 2101: 
 2102: - purchase price;
 2103: - settlement date;
 2104: - initial buying costs;
 2105: - property-growth schedule;
 2106: - renovation capital events;
 2107: - selling-cost assumptions;
 2108: - sale date;
 2109: - ownership percentage.
 2110: 
 2111: Outputs:
 2112: 
 2113: - projected property value;
 2114: - gross equity;
 2115: - net sale equity after selected costs;
 2116: - LVR over time;
 2117: - ownership cash outlay;
 2118: - nominal and real cost-of-ownership views.
 2119: 
 2120: ### 12.5.6 Stress Testing
 2121: 
 2122: The user can apply:
 2123: 
 2124: - parallel rate shifts;
 2125: - custom rate path;
 2126: - repayment shock at a selected date;
 2127: - income reduction imported from a pay scenario;
 2128: - offset withdrawal;
 2129: - property-value decline;
 2130: - delayed refinance;
 2131: - combination stress scenario.
 2132: 
 2133: The product MUST not call a user â€œsafeâ€ or â€œapproved.â€ It reports cash-flow and model outcomes.
 2134: 
 2135: ### 12.5.7 Outputs
 2136: 
 2137: - current and future repayment schedule;
 2138: - daily/monthly balance timeline;
 2139: - principal and interest totals;
 2140: - fee total;
 2141: - interest saved by offset and extra repayments;
 2142: - time saved;
 2143: - refinance cost and break-even;
 2144: - component-level and consolidated results;
 2145: - property value and equity timeline;
 2146: - minimum cash-flow period;
 2147: - largest repayment shock;
 2148: - nominal cost;
 2149: - present-value cost for applicable long horizons;
 2150: - scenario delta versus baseline.
 2151: 
 2152: ### 12.5.8 Ledger Invariants
 2153: 
 2154: - Principal cannot become negative except as an explicit credit-balance state supported by the contract model.
 2155: - Offset cannot reduce interest-bearing principal below the configured floor.
 2156: - Every cash flow appears exactly once.
 2157: - Opening balance + drawdowns + capitalised interest + fees - principal payments = closing balance, subject only to disclosed rounding.
 2158: - Interest charged equals the sum of accrued interest included in the charge period, subject to disclosed rounding.
 2159: - Component totals reconcile to the portfolio total.
 2160: - A refinance closes the old component before opening the new component according to event order.
 2161: - No event occurs outside its effective interval.
 2162: 
 2163: ### 12.5.9 Acceptance Criteria
 2164: 
 2165: - **MORT-AC-001:** A constant-rate simple scenario reconciles to the closed-form engine within the expected timing tolerance.
 2166: - **MORT-AC-002:** Daily accrual includes leap-day behaviour under each supported day-count convention.
 2167: - **MORT-AC-003:** Weekly and fortnightly extra repayments are first-class recurring events.
 2168: - **MORT-AC-004:** An offset withdrawal increases subsequent interest but not principal on the withdrawal date unless another event does so.
 2169: - **MORT-AC-005:** A rate change applies on its configured effective date and order.
 2170: - **MORT-AC-006:** Compare mode uses identical starting facts unless deliberately overridden.
 2171: - **MORT-AC-007:** The report identifies whether results are quick, scheduled or daily simulation.
 2172: - **MORT-AC-008:** A non-amortising scenario returns a warning and estimated unresolved balance.
 2173: - **MORT-AC-009:** The final schedule can be exported to CSV without losing dates, component IDs or event descriptions.
 2174: - **MORT-AC-010:** Interest, principal, fees and closing balances reconcile for every period.
 2175: - **MORT-AC-011:** A saved scenario replayed under its original engine and rule versions reproduces the original result hash.
 2176: - **MORT-AC-012:** Forecast property values are visually and semantically separated from contractual loan balances.
 2177: 
 2178: ### 12.5.10 Required Disclosure
 2179: 
 2180: The model is an estimate based on the selected contract conventions and future assumptions. Lender methods, transaction timing, fees, rounding and rate changes may differ. Users should compare the settings with their loan contract and statements.
 2181:

 2229: 
 2230: ### Inputs
 2231: 
 2232: #### Existing Loan
 2233: 
 2234: - balance;
 2235: - remaining term;
 2236: - current rate path;
 2237: - scheduled repayments;
 2238: - annual/package fees;
 2239: - discharge fee;
 2240: - fixed-rate break cost;
 2241: - lost benefits or offset arrangements.
 2242: 
 2243: #### New Loan
 2244: 
 2245: - new interest rate path;
 2246: - term;
 2247: - repayment type;
 2248: - establishment fee;
 2249: - valuation, settlement and legal costs;
 2250: - annual/package fees;
 2251: - cashback;

 2253: - financed versus cash-paid switching costs;
 2254: - offset or redraw differences.
 2255: 
 2256: ### Outputs
 2257: 
 2258: - upfront net switching cost;
 2259: - repayment difference;
 2260: - monthly cash-flow difference;
 2261: - cumulative savings timeline;
 2262: - nominal break-even date;
 2263: - discounted break-even date;
 2264: - interest and fee difference over selected horizon;
 2265: - effect of resetting loan term;
 2266: - balance difference at common comparison date;
 2267: - no-break-even result where applicable.
 2268: 
 2269: ### Comparison Rule
 2270: 
 2271: Scenarios MUST be compared at a common horizon and with residual balances included. Comparing only monthly repayments is prohibited.
 2272: 
 2273: ### Acceptance Criteria
 2274: 
 2275: - A cashback is not represented as savings until its conditions and timing are applied.
 2276: - Financed switching costs accrue interest in the new-loan scenario.
 2277: - A longer new term shows lower repayments and any increased lifetime cost.
 2278: - Break-even uses cumulative net difference and handles multiple crossings.
 2279: - The first sustainable crossing SHOULD be reported, with later reversals disclosed.
 2280: 
### 2965-3005
 2965: 
 2966: ## 13.9 Offset treatment
 2967: 
 2968: Default Australian mortgage behaviour:
 2969: 
 2970: \[
 2971: InterestBearingBalance_d = \max(0, LoanBalance_d - OffsetBalance_d)
 2972: \]
 2973: 
 2974: Offset deposits do not reduce principal. Offset withdrawals do not create a loan draw unless the actual loan product and scenario explicitly model linked sweep behaviour.
 2975: 
 2976: ## 13.10 Refinance break-even
 2977: 
 2978: For old-loan and new-loan cumulative user cash outflows through date `d`:
 2979: 
 2980: \[
 2981: Delta_d = CumulativeOld_d - CumulativeNew_d - SwitchingCosts_d + Cashbacks_d
 2982: \]
 2983: 
 2984: The primary break-even date is the earliest date where `Delta_d >= 0` and remains non-negative for the configured confirmation window. The engine SHOULD also report temporary crossings.
 2985: 
 2986: At a common comparison horizon, residual balances MUST be included:
 2987: 
 2988: \[
 2989: EconomicCost = CumulativeCashOutflow + ResidualDebt - ResidualCashAssets
 2990: \]
 2991: 
 2992: ## 13.11 Future value with regular contributions
 2993: 
 2994: For end-of-period contribution `C`, periodic rate `i`, and `n` periods:
 2995: 
 2996: \[
 2997: FV = P(1+i)^n + C\left(\frac{(1+i)^n-1}{i}\right)
 2998: \]
 2999: 
 3000: For beginning-of-period contributions, multiply the contribution term by `(1+i)`.
 3001: 
 3002: Date-aware schedules MUST use event simulation instead of this closed form when contributions, rates or fees change.
 3003:

### apps/web/lib/use-ledger.ts
    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
    4: import {
    5:   compareRefinance,
    6:   compareToBaseline,
    7:   runLedger,
    8: } from "@paymentcalcs/engine-mortgage-ledger";
    9: import { serializeLedger, serializeRefinance } from "./ledger-serialize";
   10: import type { LedgerWorkerRequest, LedgerWorkerResponse } from "../workers/ledger.worker";
   11: 
   12: type Job = LedgerWorkerRequest["job"];
   13: 
   14: /**
   15:  * Runs ledger jobs in a Web Worker (Â§22.4) with a synchronous main-thread
   16:  * fallback when workers are unavailable. Results are the serialized forms.
   17:  */
   18: export function useLedgerJob<TResult>(job: Job | null): {
   19:   result: TResult | null;
   20:   running: boolean;
   21:   error: string | null;
   22: } {
   23:   const workerRef = useRef<Worker | null>(null);
   24:   const idRef = useRef(0);
   25:   const [state, setState] = useState<{ result: TResult | null; running: boolean; error: string | null }>({
   26:     result: null,
   27:     running: false,
   28:     error: null,
   29:   });
   30: 
   31:   useEffect(() => {
   32:     if (typeof Worker !== "undefined" && workerRef.current === null) {
   33:       try {
   34:         workerRef.current = new Worker(new URL("../workers/ledger.worker.ts", import.meta.url));
   35:       } catch {
   36:         workerRef.current = null;
   37:       }
   38:     }
   39:     return () => {
   40:       workerRef.current?.terminate();
   41:       workerRef.current = null;
   42:     };
   43:   }, []);
   44: 
   45:   useEffect(() => {
   46:     if (!job) {
   47:       setState({ result: null, running: false, error: null });
   48:       return;
   49:     }
   50:     const id = ++idRef.current;
   51:     setState((s) => ({ ...s, running: true, error: null }));
   52: 
   53:     const worker = workerRef.current;
   54:     if (worker) {
   55:       const onMessage = (event: MessageEvent<LedgerWorkerResponse>) => {
   56:         if (event.data.protocol !== "pc-ledger-v1" || event.data.id !== id) return;
   57:         if (id !== idRef.current) return; // stale
   58:         worker.removeEventListener("message", onMessage);
   59:         if (event.data.ok) {
   60:           setState({ result: event.data.result as TResult, running: false, error: null });
   61:         } else {
   62:           setState({ result: null, running: false, error: event.data.error ?? "calculation failed" });
   63:         }
   64:       };
   65:       worker.addEventListener("message", onMessage);
   66:       const request: LedgerWorkerRequest = { protocol: "pc-ledger-v1", id, job };
   67:       worker.postMessage(request);
   68:       return () => worker.removeEventListener("message", onMessage);
   69:     }
   70: 
   71:     // Main-thread fallback.
   72:     try {
   73:       let result: unknown;
   74:       if (job.kind === "run") result = serializeLedger(runLedger(job.input));
   75:       else if (job.kind === "compare") {
   76:         const compared = compareToBaseline(job.input);
   77:         result = {
   78:           scenario: serializeLedger(compared.scenario),
   79:           baseline: serializeLedger(compared.baseline),
   80:           interestSaved: compared.interestSaved.toFixed(2),
   81:           periodsSaved: compared.periodsSaved,
   82:         };
   83:       } else result = serializeRefinance(compareRefinance(job.oldInput, job.newInput, job.costs));
   84:       setState({ result: result as TResult, running: false, error: null });
   85:     } catch (error) {
   86:       setState({
   87:         result: null,
   88:         running: false,
   89:         error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "calculation failed",
   90:       });
   91:     }
   92:   }, [job]);
   93: 
   94:   return state;
   95: }

  203: function primaryAmount(variant: PayVariant, output: AuPayOutput, state: PayFormState): Money {
  204:   switch (variant.primaryMetric) {
  205:     case "netAnnual":
  206:       return output.netAnnualCash;
  207:     case "annualBase":

  209:     case "impliedHourly": {

  211:       const weeks = new Dec(state.weeksPaidRaw.trim() || "52");
  212:       const annual = moneyToDecimal(output.annualised.baseSalary) as DecimalValue;
  213:       const divisor = hours.times(weeks);
  214:       const hourly = divisor.isZero() ? new Dec(0) : annual.div(divisor);
  215:       return {
  216:         ...output.annualised.baseSalary,
  217:         minorUnits: hourly.times(100).toDecimalPlaces(0, Dec.ROUND_HALF_UP).toFixed(0),
  218:       };
  219:     }
  220:     default:
  221:       return output.netPerCycle;
  222:   }

   26: export const PPY: Record<LoanFrequencyKind, number> = { weekly: 52, fortnightly: 26, monthly: 12 };

   28: export interface ParsedLoanBasics {
   29:   principal: string;
   30:   annualRate: string;
   31:   termPeriods: number;
   32:   ioPeriods: number;
   33:   frequency: LoanFrequencyKind;
   34:   errors: Record<string, string>;
   35:   ok: boolean;
   36: }
   37: 
   38: export function parseLoanBasics(state: LoanBasicsState): ParsedLoanBasics {
   39:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
   40:   const principal = parseMoneyInput(state.principalRaw);
   41:   if (!principal.ok) {
   42:     if (principal.error) errors.principal = principal.error;
   43:   } else if (principal.money.minorUnits.startsWith("-")) {
   44:     errors.principal = "The loan amount must be positive.";
   45:   }
   46:   if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(state.ratePctRaw.trim())) {
   47:     errors.rate = "Enter the annual rate as a percentage, like 5.99.";
   48:   } else if (Number.parseFloat(state.ratePctRaw) > 30) {
   49:     errors.rate = "Rates above 30% are outside this calculator's domain.";
   50:   }
   51:   if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(state.termYearsRaw.trim()) || Number.parseFloat(state.termYearsRaw) <= 0 || Number.parseFloat(state.termYearsRaw) > 40) {
   52:     errors.term = "Term must be between 1 and 40 years.";
   53:   }
   54:   if (state.interestOnly && (!/^\d+$/.test(state.ioYearsRaw.trim()) || Number.parseInt(state.ioYearsRaw, 10) >= Number.parseFloat(state.termYearsRaw || "0"))) {
   55:     errors.io = "Interest-only years must be a whole number shorter than the term.";
   56:   }
   57:   const ok = Object.keys(errors).length === 0 && principal.ok;
   58:   const ppy = PPY[state.frequency];
   59:   return {
   60:     principal: principal.ok ? moneyToDecimalString(principal.money) : "0",
   61:     annualRate: ok ? (Number.parseFloat(state.ratePctRaw) / 100).toString() : "0",
   62:     termPeriods: ok ? Math.round(Number.parseFloat(state.termYearsRaw) * ppy) : 0,
   63:     ioPeriods: ok && state.interestOnly ? Number.parseInt(state.ioYearsRaw, 10) * ppy : 0,
   64:     frequency: state.frequency,
   65:     errors,
   66:     ok,
   67:   };
   68: }
