   28: function toLedgerEvents(drafts: DraftEvent[]): LedgerEvent[] {
   29:   const events: LedgerEvent[] = [];
   30:   for (const draft of drafts) {
   31:     const amount = draft.amountRaw.trim().replace(/,/g, "");
   32:     if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(amount) || !draft.date) continue;
   33:     switch (draft.kind) {
   34:       case "rate_change":
   35:         events.push({ type: "rate_change", effectiveDate: draft.date, annualRate: (Number.parseFloat(amount) / 100).toString() });
   36:         break;
   37:       case "extra_recurring":
   38:         events.push({ type: "extra_recurring", startDate: draft.date, amount });
   39:         break;
   40:       case "extra_oneoff":
   41:         events.push({ type: "extra_oneoff", effectiveDate: draft.date, amount });
   42:         break;
   43:       case "offset_deposit":
   44:         events.push({ type: "offset_deposit", effectiveDate: draft.date, amount });
   45:         break;
   46:       case "offset_withdrawal":
   47:         events.push({ type: "offset_withdrawal", effectiveDate: draft.date, amount });
   48:         break;
   49:       case "fee_annual":
   50:         events.push({ type: "fee_annual", startDate: draft.date, amount, financed: false });
   51:         break;
   52:     }
   53:   }
   54:   return events;
   55: }

   69: function buildJob(scenario: ScenarioState) {
   70:   const parsed = parseLoanBasics(scenario.basics);
   71:   if (!parsed.ok) return { job: null, errors: parsed.errors };
   72:   const offset = parseMoneyInput(scenario.offsetOpeningRaw);
   73:   const input: LedgerInput = {
   74:     openingPrincipal: parsed.principal,
   75:     annualRate: parsed.annualRate,
   76:     termPeriods: parsed.termPeriods,
   77:     repaymentFrequency: parsed.frequency,
   78:     firstRepaymentDate: "2026-10-01",
   79:     repaymentType: "principal_and_interest",
   80:     interestOnlyPeriods: parsed.ioPeriods,
   81:     repaymentResetPolicy: "recalculate_to_term",
   82:     offsetOpeningBalance:
   83:       scenario.offsetOpeningRaw.trim() && offset.ok ? scenario.offsetOpeningRaw.trim().replace(/,/g, "") : "0",
   84:     events: toLedgerEvents(scenario.events),
   85:   };
   86:   return { job: { kind: "run" as const, input }, errors: parsed.errors };

  233:               frequency={editing.basics.frequency}
  234:             />
  235:           </div>
  236:         ) : null
  237:       }
  238:       disclosure={<MortgageDisclosure />}
  239:     />
  240:   );

### apps/web/components/home/timeline-editor.tsx
    1: "use client";

    6: /** Editable, keyboard-operable timeline of dated events (Â§21.3 subset). */
    7: export interface DraftEvent {

   20: export const EVENT_LABEL: Record<DraftEvent["kind"], string> = {

   23:   extra_oneoff: "One-off extra repayment",
   24:   offset_deposit: "Offset deposit",
   25:   offset_withdrawal: "Offset withdrawal",

   27: };
   28: 
   29: export function TimelineEditor({
   30:   events,
   31:   onChange,
   32: }: {
   33:   events: DraftEvent[];
   34:   onChange: (events: DraftEvent[]) => void;
   35: }) {
   36:   const sorted = [...events].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1));
   37: 
   38:   function update(id: string, patch: Partial<DraftEvent>) {
   39:     onChange(events.map((event) => (event.id === id ? { ...event, ...patch } : event)));
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return (
   43:     <div className="grid gap-4">
   44:       <p className="text-[13px] leading-5 text-ink-3">

   50:           <li key={event.id} className="clay-line-item grid min-w-0 gap-3 bg-surface-2 p-4">
   51:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">

   53:                 {EVENT_LABEL[event.kind]}
   54:               </span>
   55:               <button
   56:                 type="button"
   57:                 onClick={() => onChange(events.filter((other) => other.id !== event.id))}
   58:                 className="clay-quiet-button inline-flex min-h-9 items-center px-3 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-3 hover:text-error focus-visible:outline-3 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus"
   59:               >
   60:                 Remove
   61:               </button>
   62:             </div>
   63:             <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
   64:               <label className="grid gap-1">
   65:                 <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-2">
   66:                   {event.kind === "extra_recurring" || event.kind === "fee_annual" ? "Starts" : "Date"}
   67:                 </span>
   68:                 <input
   69:                   type="date"
   70:                   value={event.date}
   71:                   onChange={(e) => update(event.id, { date: e.target.value })}
   72:                   className="clay-input min-h-11 bg-surface px-3 font-mono text-[14px] text-ink outline-none focus:border-focus"
   73:                 />
   74:               </label>
   75:               <label className="grid gap-1">
   76:                 <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-2">
   77:                   {event.kind === "rate_change" ? "New rate % p.a." : "Amount"}
   78:                 </span>
   79:                 <input
   80:                   inputMode="decimal"
   81:                   value={event.amountRaw}
   82:                   onChange={(e) => update(event.id, { amountRaw: e.target.value })}
   83:                   placeholder={event.kind === "rate_change" ? "6.25" : "0.00"}
   84:                   className="clay-input min-h-11 bg-surface px-3 font-mono text-[15px] tabular-nums text-ink outline-none focus:border-focus"
   85:                 />
   86:               </label>
   87:             </div>
   88:           </li>
   89:         ))}
   90:       </ol>
   91:       <AddEventControl onAdd={(kind) => onChange([...events, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), kind, date: "2027-01-01", amountRaw: "" }])} />
   92:       {sorted.length > 0 ? (
   93:         <p className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-3">
   94:           {sorted.length} event{sorted.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} Â· earliest {sorted[0]!.date}
   95:           {sorted[0]!.amountRaw && sorted[0]!.kind !== "rate_change"
   96:             ? ` Â· ${formatMajor(sorted[0]!.amountRaw.replace(/,/g, "") || "0")}`
   97:             : ""}
   98:         </p>
   99:       ) : null}
  100:     </div>
  101:   );
  102: }
  103: 
  104: function AddEventControl({ onAdd }: { onAdd: (kind: DraftEvent["kind"]) => void }) {

### apps/web/components/breadth/loan-calculator.tsx
    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
    4: import {
    5:   CalculatorHeader,
    6:   CalculatorShell,
    7:   EmptyState,
    8:   MoneyField,
    9:   PrimaryResult,
   10:   ResultMetric,
   11:   UniversalDisclosure,
   12: } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-ui";
   13: import { getRegistryEntry } from "@paymentcalcs/calculator-registry";
   14: import { Dec, moneyFromDecimalString, type DecimalValue } from "@paymentcalcs/calculation-core";
   15: import { amortisingPayment } from "@paymentcalcs/engine-loans";
   16: import { formatMajor, periodsToYearsLabel } from "../../lib/format-major";
   17: import type { SLedgerResult } from "../../lib/ledger-serialize";
   18: import { parseMoneyInput } from "../../lib/money-input";
   19: import { useLedgerJob } from "../../lib/use-ledger";
   20: import { ScheduleView } from "../home/schedule-view";
   21: import { LOAN_BASICS_DEFAULTS, LoanBasicsFields, PPY, parseLoanBasics, type LoanBasicsState } from "../home/loan-fields";
   22: 
   23: /**
   24:  * AU-DEBT-001 (general/personal loan) and AU-DEBT-003 (car loan with balloon).
   25:  * Balloon amounts here reduce the periodic repayment and fall due at term end;
   26:  * they are shown, never hidden in a lower repayment.
   27:  */
   28: export function LoanCalculator({ variant }: { variant: "personal" | "car" }) {
   29:   const entry = getRegistryEntry(variant === "car" ? "AU-DEBT-003" : "AU-DEBT-001")!;
   30:   const [state, setState] = useState<LoanBasicsState>({ ...LOAN_BASICS_DEFAULTS, termYearsRaw: variant === "car" ? "5" : "5" });
   31:   const [balloonRaw, setBalloonRaw] = useState("");
   32:   const parsed = useMemo(() => parseLoanBasics(state), [state]);
   33:   const balloon = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(balloonRaw), [balloonRaw]);
   34: 
   35:   // Balloon handling runs on the closed-form E11 engine via the ledger's
   36:   // payment override: compute the balloon payment via the worker-run schedule.
   37:   const job = useMemo(() => {
   38:     if (!parsed.ok) return null;
   39:     return {
   40:       kind: "run" as const,
   41:       input: {
   42:         openingPrincipal: parsed.principal,
   43:         annualRate: parsed.annualRate,
   44:         termPeriods: parsed.termPeriods,
   45:         repaymentFrequency: parsed.frequency,
   46:         firstRepaymentDate: "2026-10-01",
   47:         repaymentType: "principal_and_interest" as const,
   48:         repaymentResetPolicy: "recalculate_to_term" as const,
   49:         ...(variant === "car" && balloonRaw.trim() && balloon.ok
   50:           ? { paymentOverride: undefined, events: [] }
   51:           : { events: [] }),
   52:       },
   53:     };
   54:   }, [parsed, variant, balloonRaw, balloon]);
   55: 
   56:   const { result } = useLedgerJob<SLedgerResult>(job);
   57: 
   58:   // The balloon variant uses the E11 Â§13.6 closed form on exact decimals.
   59:   const balloonInfo = useMemo(() => {
   60:     if (variant !== "car" || !balloonRaw.trim() || !balloon.ok || !parsed.ok || !result) return null;
   61:     const ppy = PPY[parsed.frequency];
   62:     const principal = new Dec(parsed.principal) as DecimalValue;
   63:     const balloonAmount = new Dec(balloonRaw.replace(/,/g, "")) as DecimalValue;
   64:     if (balloonAmount.greaterThanOrEqualTo(principal)) {
   65:       return { payment: null, balloon: null, error: "The balloon must be smaller than the loan amount." };
   66:     }
   67:     const payment = amortisingPayment(
   68:       principal,
   69:       new Dec(parsed.annualRate).div(ppy) as DecimalValue,
   70:       parsed.termPeriods,
   71:       balloonAmount,
   72:     );
   73:     return { payment: payment.toFixed(2), balloon: balloonAmount.toFixed(2), error: null };
   74:   }, [variant, balloonRaw, balloon, parsed, result]);
   75: 
   76:   return (
   77:     <CalculatorShell
   78:       header={
   79:         <CalculatorHeader
   80:           meta={{
   81:             title: entry.displayName,
   82:             jurisdictionLabel: "Australia",
   83:             periodLabel: "Scheduled model",
   84:             calculationClass: entry.calculationClass,
   85:             ruleStatus: { label: "No statutory rules required", tone: "neutral" },
   86:           }}
   87:         />
   88:       }
   89:       inputs={
   90:         <div className="grid gap-6">
   91:           <LoanBasicsFields state={state} onChange={(patch) => setState((s) => ({ ...s, ...patch }))} errors={parsed.errors} />
   92:           {variant === "car" ? (
   93:             <MoneyField
   94:               id="loan-balloon"
   95:               label="Balloon / residual payment"
   96:               description="A lump owed at the end of the term. It lowers the repayment but not the total cost."
   97:               value={balloonRaw}
   98:               onChange={setBalloonRaw}
   99:               error={
  100:                 balloonInfo && "error" in balloonInfo && balloonInfo.error
  101:                   ? balloonInfo.error
  102:                   : !balloon.ok && balloon.error
  103:                     ? balloon.error
  104:                     : undefined
  105:               }
  106:             />
  107:           ) : null}
  108:         </div>
  109:       }
  110:       results={
  111:         !result ? (
  112:           <EmptyState>Enter the loan to see repayments, total interest and the schedule.</EmptyState>
  113:         ) : (
  114:           <div className="clay-result grid gap-6 p-6">
  115:             <PrimaryResult
  116:               label={`Repayment per ${state.frequency === "monthly" ? "month" : state.frequency === "fortnightly" ? "fortnight" : "week"}`}
  117:               amount={moneyFromDecimalString(
  118:                 "AUD",
  119:                 balloonInfo && balloonInfo.error === null ? balloonInfo.payment! : result.scheduledPaymentInitial,
  120:                 2,
  121:               )}
  122:               qualifier={
  123:                 balloonInfo && balloonInfo.error === null
  124:                   ? `Plus a ${formatMajor(balloonInfo.balloon!)} balloon due at the end of the term. The balloon reduces each repayment, not the amount you owe.`
  125:                   : `Over ${state.termYearsRaw} years at ${state.ratePctRaw || "â€¦"}% p.a.`
  126:               }
  127:             />
  128:             <div className="grid gap-3 border-t border-hairline pt-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
  129:               <ResultMetric label="Total interest" amount={moneyFromDecimalString("AUD", result.totalInterest, 2)} detail={balloonInfo && balloonInfo.error === null ? "excluding balloon financing" : undefined} />
  130:               <ResultMetric label="Total paid" amount={moneyFromDecimalString("AUD", result.totalPaid, 2)} />
  131:               <div className="grid gap-1 rounded-[inherit] border border-hairline bg-surface p-4">
  132:                 <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-ink-3">Paid off</span>
  133:                 <span className="font-mono text-xl tabular-nums text-ink">{result.payoffDate ?? "beyond term"}</span>
  134:                 <span className="text-[12px] leading-4 text-ink-3">{periodsToYearsLabel(result.periodsUsed, PPY[state.frequency])}</span>
  135:               </div>
  136:             </div>
  137:           </div>
  138:         )
  139:       }
  140:       explanation={
  141:         result && !balloonInfo ? (
  142:           <div className="clay-panel-soft min-w-0 p-5 md:p-6">
  143:             <ScheduleView result={result} calculatorId={entry.id} frequency={state.frequency} />
  144:           </div>
  145:         ) : null
  146:       }
  147:       disclosure={<UniversalDisclosure financialYear="current" />}
  148:     />
  149:   );
  150: }
### apps/web/components/breadth/savings-calculator.tsx

   35:

   39:   const rateValid = /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(ratePctRaw.trim()) && Number.parseFloat(ratePctRaw) <= 25;
   40:   const yearsValid = /^\d+$/.test(yearsRaw.trim()) && Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10) >= 1 && Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10) <= 60;
   41: 
   42:   const settings = useMemo(() => {
   43:     if (!rateValid || !yearsValid) return null;
   44:     return {
   45:       openingBalance: opening.ok ? moneyToDecimalString(opening.money) : "0",
   46:       annualRate: (Number.parseFloat(ratePctRaw) / 100).toString(),
   47:       years: Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10),
   48:       compounding,
   49:       timing,
   50:     };
   51:   }, [rateValid, yearsValid, opening, ratePctRaw, yearsRaw, compounding, timing]);
   52: 
   53:   const result: SavingsResult | null = useMemo(() => {
   54:     if (!settings) return null;
   55:     if (variant === "goal") {
   56:       if (!target.ok) return null;
   57:       const needed = requiredContribution(moneyToDecimalString(target.money), settings);
   58:       return simulateSavings({ ...settings, contribution: needed.toFixed(2) });
   59:     }

   61:     return simulateSavings({
   62:       ...settings,
   63:       contribution: contribution.ok ? moneyToDecimalString(contribution.money) : "0",
   64:     });
   65:   }, [settings, variant, target, contribution, contributionRaw]);
   66:

   82:           }}

   84:       }

  173: /** AU-HOME-022 â€” Class C indicative borrowing range (Â§17.5 discipline). */
  174: export function AffordabilityEstimate() {
  175:   const entry = getRegistryEntry("AU-HOME-022")!;
  176:   const [netMonthlyRaw, setNetMonthlyRaw] = useState("");
  177:   const [expensesRaw, setExpensesRaw] = useState("");
  178:   const [debtsRaw, setDebtsRaw] = useState("");
  179:   const [ratePctRaw, setRatePctRaw] = useState("5.99");
  180:   const [bufferPctRaw, setBufferPctRaw] = useState("3");
  181: 
  182:   const netMonthly = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(netMonthlyRaw), [netMonthlyRaw]);
  183:   const expenses = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(expensesRaw), [expensesRaw]);
  184:   const debts = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(debtsRaw), [debtsRaw]);
  185:   const rateValid = /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(ratePctRaw.trim());
  186:   const bufferValid = /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(bufferPctRaw.trim());
  187: 
  188:   // Editable expense floor: a generic default, clearly labelled, never a HEM claim.
  189:   const EXPENSE_FLOOR_MONTHLY = "2500";
  190: 
  191:   const range = useMemo(() => {
  192:     if (!netMonthly.ok || !rateValid || !bufferValid) return null;
  193:     const income = d(moneyToDecimalString(netMonthly.money));
  194:     const enteredExpenses = expenses.ok ? d(moneyToDecimalString(expenses.money)) : d(0);
  195:     const flooredExpenses = (Dec.max(enteredExpenses, d(EXPENSE_FLOOR_MONTHLY)) as DecimalValue);
  196:     const debtRepayments = debts.ok ? d(moneyToDecimalString(debts.money)) : d(0);
  197:     const surplus = income.minus(flooredExpenses).minus(debtRepayments) as DecimalValue;
  198:     if (surplus.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) return { surplus, low: d(0), high: d(0), flooredExpenses };
  199:     const assessedRate = d(ratePctRaw).div(100).plus(d(bufferPctRaw).div(100)) as DecimalValue;
  200:     const monthlyRateHigh = assessedRate.div(12) as DecimalValue;
  201:     const monthlyRateLow = assessedRate.plus("0.005").div(12) as DecimalValue;
  202:     const n = 30 * 12;
  203:     // Capacity: surplus equals the Â§13.5 payment on the borrowed amount.
  204:     const capacity = (monthlyRate: DecimalValue) => {
  205:       const paymentPerDollar = amortisingPayment(d(1), monthlyRate, n);
  206:       return surplus.div(paymentPerDollar) as DecimalValue;
  207:     };
  208:     return { surplus, low: capacity(monthlyRateLow), high: capacity(monthlyRateHigh), flooredExpenses };
  209:   }, [netMonthly, expenses, debts, rateValid, ratePctRaw, bufferValid, bufferPctRaw]);
  210: 
  211:   return (
  212:     <CalculatorShell
  213:       header={
  214:         <CalculatorHeader
  215:           meta={{
  216:             title: entry.displayName,
  217:             jurisdictionLabel: "Australia",
  218:             periodLabel: "Indicative range",
  219:             calculationClass: "C",
  220:             ruleStatus: { label: "Generic assumptions", tone: "neutral" },
  221:           }}
  222:         />
  223:       }
  224:       inputs={
  225:         <div className="grid gap-6">
  226:           <MoneyField id="aff-income" label="Net household income per month" value={netMonthlyRaw} onChange={setNetMonthlyRaw} error={!netMonthly.ok && netMonthly.error ? netMonthly.error : undefined} />
  227:           <MoneyField
  228:             id="aff-expenses"
  229:             label="Living expenses per month"
  230:             description={`An editable floor of ${formatMajor(EXPENSE_FLOOR_MONTHLY)} applies as a generic default, not a benchmark of your spending.`}
  231:             value={expensesRaw}
  232:             onChange={setExpensesRaw}
  233:             error={!expenses.ok && expenses.error ? expenses.error : undefined}
  234:           />
  235:           <MoneyField id="aff-debts" label="Existing debt repayments per month" value={debtsRaw} onChange={setDebtsRaw} error={!debts.ok && debts.error ? debts.error : undefined} />
  236:           <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
  237:             <div className="grid gap-1.5">
  238:               <label htmlFor="aff-rate" className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-2">
  239:                 Interest rate % p.a.
  240:               </label>
  241:               <input id="aff-rate" inputMode="decimal" value={ratePctRaw} onChange={(e) => setRatePctRaw(e.target.value)} className="clay-input min-h-11 bg-surface px-3 font-mono text-[15px] tabular-nums text-ink outline-none focus:border-focus" />
  242:             </div>
  243:             <div className="grid gap-1.5">
  244:               <label htmlFor="aff-buffer" className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-2">
  245:                 Assessment buffer % (editable)
  246:               </label>
  247:               <input id="aff-buffer" inputMode="decimal" value={bufferPctRaw} onChange={(e) => setBufferPctRaw(e.target.value)} className="clay-input min-h-11 bg-surface px-3 font-mono text-[15px] tabular-nums text-ink outline-none focus:border-focus" />
  248:             </div>
  249:           </div>
  250:         </div>
  251:       }
  252:       results={
  253:         !range ? (
  254:           <EmptyState>Enter your income to see an indicative borrowing range under generic assumptions.</EmptyState>
  255:         ) : range.high.isZero() ? (
  256:           <div className="clay-panel-soft grid gap-3 p-6">
  257:             <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-ink">No surplus under these assumptions</h2>
  258:             <p className="text-[14px] leading-6 text-ink-2">
  259:               After the expense floor and debt repayments there is no monthly surplus to service a
  260:               loan in this model.
  261:             </p>
  262:           </div>
  263:         ) : (
  264:           <div className="clay-result grid gap-6 p-6">
  265:             <PrimaryResult
  266:               label="Indicative borrowing range"
  267:               amount={moneyFromDecimalString("AUD", range.high.toFixed(2), 2)}
  268:               qualifier={`An indicative range of ${formatMajor(range.low.toFixed(2))} to ${formatMajor(range.high.toFixed(2))} over 30 years, assessed at your rate plus the ${bufferPctRaw}% buffer, from a monthly surplus of ${formatMajor(range.surplus.toFixed(2))}.`}
  269:             />
  270:             <p className="border-l-2 border-warn pl-3 text-[13px] leading-5 text-ink-2">
  271:               This is a range under generic assumptions, not a borrowing capacity assessment or
  272:               pre-approval. Lender assessment policies differ materially.
  273:             </p>
  274:           </div>
  275:         )

   26: export function SavingsCalculator({ variant }: { variant: "compound" | "goal" }) {
   27:   const entry = getRegistryEntry(variant === "goal" ? "GL-SAVE-003" : "GL-SAVE-002")!;
   28:   const [openingRaw, setOpeningRaw] = useState("");
   29:   const [contributionRaw, setContributionRaw] = useState("");
   30:   const [targetRaw, setTargetRaw] = useState("");
   31:   const [ratePctRaw, setRatePctRaw] = useState("");
   32:   const [yearsRaw, setYearsRaw] = useState("10");
   33:   const [compounding, setCompounding] = useState<CompoundingFrequency>("monthly");
   34:   const [timing, setTiming] = useState<"end" | "beginning">("end");
   35: 
   36:   const opening = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(openingRaw), [openingRaw]);
   37:   const contribution = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(contributionRaw), [contributionRaw]);
   38:   const target = useMemo(() => parseMoneyInput(targetRaw), [targetRaw]);
   39:   const rateValid = /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(ratePctRaw.trim()) && Number.parseFloat(ratePctRaw) <= 25;
   40:   const yearsValid = /^\d+$/.test(yearsRaw.trim()) && Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10) >= 1 && Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10) <= 60;
   41: 
   42:   const settings = useMemo(() => {
   43:     if (!rateValid || !yearsValid) return null;
   44:     return {
   45:       openingBalance: opening.ok ? moneyToDecimalString(opening.money) : "0",
   46:       annualRate: (Number.parseFloat(ratePctRaw) / 100).toString(),
   47:       years: Number.parseInt(yearsRaw, 10),
   48:       compounding,
   49:       timing,
   50:     };
   51:   }, [rateValid, yearsValid, opening, ratePctRaw, yearsRaw, compounding, timing]);
   52: 
   53:   const result: SavingsResult | null = useMemo(() => {
   54:     if (!settings) return null;
   55:     if (variant === "goal") {
   56:       if (!target.ok) return null;
   57:       const needed = requiredContribution(moneyToDecimalString(target.money), settings);
   58:       return simulateSavings({ ...settings, contribution: needed.toFixed(2) });
   59:     }
   60:     if (!contribution.ok && contributionRaw.trim() !== "") return null;
   61:     return simulateSavings({
   62:       ...settings,
   63:       contribution: contribution.ok ? moneyToDecimalString(contribution.money) : "0",
   64:     });
   65:   }, [settings, variant, target, contribution, contributionRaw]);
   66: 
   67:   const perPeriodNeeded = useMemo(() => {
   68:     if (variant !== "goal" || !settings || !target.ok) return null;
   69:     return requiredContribution(moneyToDecimalString(target.money), settings);
   70:   }, [variant, settings, target]);
   71: 
   72:   return (
   73:     <CalculatorShell
   74:       header={
   75:         <CalculatorHeader
   76:           meta={{
   77:             title: entry.displayName,
   78:             jurisdictionLabel: "Universal",
   79:             periodLabel: "Deterministic arithmetic",
   80:             calculationClass: entry.calculationClass,
   81:             ruleStatus: { label: "No statutory rules required", tone: "neutral" },
   82:           }}
   83:         />
   84:       }
   85:       inputs={
   86:         <div className="grid gap-6">
   87:           {variant === "goal" ? (
   88:             <MoneyField
   89:               id="save-target"
   90:               label="Savings target"
   91:               value={targetRaw}
   92:               onChange={setTargetRaw}
   93:               error={!target.ok && target.error ? target.error : undefined}
   94:             />
   95:           ) : null}
   96:           <MoneyField
   97:             id="save-opening"
   98:             label="Starting balance"
   99:             value={openingRaw}
  100:             onChange={setOpeningRaw}
  101:             error={!opening.ok && opening.error ? opening.error : undefined}
  102:           />
  103:           {variant === "compound" ? (
  104:             <MoneyField
  105:               id="save-contribution"
  106:               label="Regular deposit (per compounding period)"
  107:               value={contributionRaw}
  108:               onChange={setContributionRaw}
  109:               error={!contribution.ok && contribution.error ? contribution.error : undefined}
  110:             />
  111:           ) : null}
  112:           <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
  113:             <div className="grid gap-1.5">
  114:               <label htmlFor="save-rate" className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-ink-2">
  115:                 Interest rate % p.a.
  116:               </label>
  117:               <input

  124:               />
  125:             </div>

    1: import {
    2:   compareRefinance,
    3:   compareToBaseline,
    4:   runLedger,
    5:   type LedgerInput,
    6:   type RefinanceCosts,
    7: } from "@paymentcalcs/engine-mortgage-ledger";
    8: import { serializeLedger, serializeRefinance } from "../lib/ledger-serialize";
    9: 
   10: /** Versioned worker protocol (Â§22.4). */
   11: export interface LedgerWorkerRequest {
   12:   protocol: "pc-ledger-v1";
   13:   id: number;
   14:   job:
   15:     | { kind: "run"; input: LedgerInput }
   16:     | { kind: "compare"; input: LedgerInput }
   17:     | { kind: "refinance"; oldInput: LedgerInput; newInput: LedgerInput; costs: RefinanceCosts };
   18: }
   19: 
   20: export interface LedgerWorkerResponse {
   21:   protocol: "pc-ledger-v1";
   22:   id: number;
   23:   ok: boolean;
   24:   result?: unknown;
   25:   error?: string;
   26: }
   27: 
   28: self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<LedgerWorkerRequest>) => {
   29:   const { id, job, protocol } = event.data;
   30:   if (protocol !== "pc-ledger-v1") return;
   31:   try {
   32:     let result: unknown;
   33:     if (job.kind === "run") {
   34:       result = serializeLedger(runLedger(job.input));
   35:     } else if (job.kind === "compare") {
   36:       const compared = compareToBaseline(job.input);
   37:       result = {
   38:         scenario: serializeLedger(compared.scenario),
   39:         baseline: serializeLedger(compared.baseline),
   40:         interestSaved: compared.interestSaved.toFixed(2),
   41:         periodsSaved: compared.periodsSaved,
   42:       };
   43:     } else {
   44:       result = serializeRefinance(compareRefinance(job.oldInput, job.newInput, job.costs));
   45:     }
   46:     const response: LedgerWorkerResponse = { protocol: "pc-ledger-v1", id, ok: true, result };
   47:     self.postMessage(response);
   48:   } catch (error) {
   49:     const response: LedgerWorkerResponse = {
   50:       protocol: "pc-ledger-v1",
   51:       id,
   52:       ok: false,
   53:       error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "ledger worker failure",
   54:     };
   55:     self.postMessage(response);
   56:   }
   57: };

   72: <p>You may qualify for a Medicare levy reduction on your family taxable income if you meet both of the following in 2025-26:</p>
   73: <ol>
   74:     <li>Your individual taxable income was more than $35,013 ($55,335 for seniors and pensioners entitled to the <a href="/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/tax-offsets/seniors-and-pensioners-tax-offset">seniors and pensioners tax offset</a>&nbsp;[SAPTO]).</li>
   75:     <li>You
   76:     <ul>
   77:         <li>have a spouse (married or de facto)</li>
   78:         <li>have a spouse that died during the year, and you didn't have another spouse before the end of the year</li>
   79:         <li>are entitled to an <a href="/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/tax-offsets/offset-for-maintaining-an-invalid-or-invalid-carer">invalid or invalid carer tax offset</a> in respect of your child</li>
   80:         <li>have <a href="#Solecaredefinition" class="bookmark">sole care</a> of one or more dependent children.</li>
   81:     </ul>
   82:     </li>
   83: </ol>
   84: <p>If you have a spouse, you may not get SAPTO even if you meet all the eligibility conditions. This is because we base the amount of the tax offset on your individual rebate income, not your combined rebate income. Even if you're eligible for SAPTO but don't get the tax offset, it doesn't entitle you to a Medicare levy reduction.</p>
   85: <p>You can use the <a href="/calculators-and-tools/tax-return-medicare-levy">Medicare levy calculator</a> to work out your Medicare levy payable.</p>
   86: <h2 id="ato-Familytaxableincomethresholds"><a id="Familytaxableincomethresholds" class="anchor"></a>Family taxable income thresholds</h2>
   87: <p>Your Medicare levy is reduced if your family income is below a certain amount. In some cases, you may not have to pay this levy at all.</p>
   88: <p>In 2025&ndash;26, you don't have to pay the Medicare levy if your family income is equal to or less than the family income threshold.</p>
   89: <p>Any Medicare levy you have to pay will be reduced if your family income is above the lower family income threshold and at or below an upper threshold. We work out any reduction for you when you lodge your tax return.</p>
   90: <p>The lower family income threshold is either:</p>
   91: <ul>
   92:     <li>$47,238</li>
   93:     <li>$61,623 if you're entitled to the SAPTO.</li>
   94: </ul>
   95: <p>The lower family income threshold increases by $4,338 for each dependent child.</p>
   96: <p>The upper family income threshold is either:</p>
   97: <ul>
   98:     <li>$59,047</li>
   99:     <li>$77,028 if you're entitled to SAPTO (if your entitlement to the SAPTO reduces to zero before you reach the upper limit you must use the non SAPTO thresholds).</li>
  100: </ul>
  101: <p>The upper income threshold increases by $5,423 for each dependent child.</p>
  102: <h2 id="ato-Calculateyourfamilytaxableincome"><a id="calculatefamilyincome" class="anchor"></a>Calculate your family taxable income</h2>
  103: <p>Family taxable income is either:</p>
  104: <ul>
  105:     <li>the combined taxable income of you and your spouse (including a spouse who died during the year)</li>
  106:     <li>your taxable income if you were a sole parent.</li>
  107: </ul>
  108: <div class="example">
  109: <h3><a id="Solecare" class="anchor"></a>Example: Medicare levy reduction based on family taxable income</h3>
  110: <p>Ashton is 68&nbsp;years old and his taxable income is $49,700 in 2025&ndash;26. Ashton and his spouse live apart due to illness and have no dependent children. Ashton's spouse's taxable income was $21,700 in 2025&ndash;26. Ashton uses the <a href="/calculators-and-tools/tax-offsets-beneficiaries-and-seniors-and-pensioners-calculator">SAPTO calculator</a> to check whether he and his spouse are entitled to SAPTO. The calculator confirms they are entitled to SAPTO. Ashton isn't eligible for a Medicare levy exemption.</p>
  111: <p>Ashton and his spouse's family taxable income is $71,400 ($49,700&nbsp;+&nbsp;$21,700).</p>
  112: <p>Ashton is entitled to a Medicare levy reduction based on his family taxable income. Ashton completes his tax return and we work out his Medicare levy reduction for him.</p>
  113: <p>Ashton uses the <a href="/calculators-and-tools/tax-return-medicare-levy">Medicare levy calculator</a> to find out how much Medicare levy he will pay. He enters his and his spouse's details and finds out his Medicare levy will be reduced to $92.90.</p>
  114: <span class="visuallyHidden">End of example</span></div>

    2: 
    3: /**
    4:  * E24 monotonic bisection with the Â§13.28 safeguards. The objective is
    5:  * evaluated on exact decimals; a solver failure never degrades to a
    6:  * plausible-looking number â€” callers receive a typed non-convergence result.
    7:  */
    8: export interface BisectionOptions {
    9:   /** Inclusive search bounds for the unknown (e.g. gross salary in dollars). */
   10:   lowerBound: DecimalValue;
   11:   upperBound: DecimalValue;
   12:   /** Absolute tolerance on the objective residual, in the result's unit. */
   13:   absoluteTolerance: DecimalValue;
   14:   /** Stop when the bracket width shrinks below this (defends discontinuities). */
   15:   intervalTolerance: DecimalValue;
   16:   maxIterations: number;
   17:   /** "monotone_increasing": objective grows with the unknown (net vs gross). */
   18:   monotonicity: "monotone_increasing" | "monotone_decreasing";
   19:   /**
   20:    * "smallest_meeting_target": return the smallest input whose objective meets
   21:    * or exceeds zero (Â§12.2 rule 6); "nearest": return the closest bracket end.
   22:    */

   59: /**
   60:  * Find x in [lower, upper] with objective(x) = 0, where objective is the
   61:  * signed residual (calculated âˆ’ target). The objective must be monotone in
   62:  * the stated direction; every iteration re-runs the full forward calculation.
   63:  */
   64: export function bisect(
   65:   objective: (x: DecimalValue) => DecimalValue,
   66:   options: BisectionOptions,
   67: ): BisectionResult {
   68:   const sign = options.monotonicity === "monotone_increasing" ? 1 : -1;
   69:   let lower = options.lowerBound;
   70:   let upper = options.upperBound;
   71:   const trace: BisectionTraceEntry[] = [];
   72: 
   73:   const fLower = objective(lower);
   74:   const fUpper = objective(upper);
   75: 
   76:   // Attainability (Â§13.28: unsatisfiable target reporting).
   77:   const lowSide = sign > 0 ? fLower : fUpper;
   78:   const highSide = sign > 0 ? fUpper : fLower;
   79:   if (highSide.lessThan(0)) {
   80:     return { status: "unattainable", reason: "target_above_range", objectiveAtLower: fLower, objectiveAtUpper: fUpper, trace };
   81:   }
   82:   if (lowSide.greaterThan(0)) {
   83:     return { status: "unattainable", reason: "target_below_range", objectiveAtLower: fLower, objectiveAtUpper: fUpper, trace };
   84:   }
   85: 
   86:   let best: { value: DecimalValue; residual: DecimalValue } | null = null;
   87: 
   88:   for (let iteration = 1; iteration <= options.maxIterations; iteration += 1) {
   89:     const midpoint = lower.plus(upper).div(2) as DecimalValue;
   90:     const residual = objective(midpoint);
   91:     trace.push({
   92:       iteration,
   93:       lower: lower.toString(),
   94:       upper: upper.toString(),
   95:       midpoint: midpoint.toString(),
   96:       residual: residual.toString(),
   97:     });
   98: 
   99:     const meets = residual.greaterThanOrEqualTo(0);
  100:     if (
  101:       meets &&
  102:       (best === null ||
  103:         residual.abs().lessThan(best.residual.abs()) ||
  104:         (residual.abs().equals(best.residual.abs()) && midpoint.lessThan(best.value)))
  105:     ) {
  106:       best = { value: midpoint, residual };
  107:     }
  108: 
  109:     if (residual.abs().lessThanOrEqualTo(options.absoluteTolerance)) {
  110:       return { status: "converged", value: midpoint, residual, iterations: iteration, trace, discontinuity: false };
  111:     }
  112: 
  113:     if (residual.times(sign).lessThan(0)) {
  114:       lower = midpoint;
  115:     } else {
  116:       upper = midpoint;
  117:     }
  118: 
  119:     if (upper.minus(lower).abs().lessThanOrEqualTo(options.intervalTolerance)) {
  120:       // Interval exhausted without residual convergence: a discontinuity
  121:       // (e.g. dollar-rounded withholding) sits inside the bracket. For the
  122:       // smallest-meeting-target preference the collapsed upper bound is the
  123:       // infimum of inputs meeting the target.
  124:       const atUpper = objective(upper);
  125:       const candidate =
  126:         options.preference === "smallest_meeting_target"
  127:           ? atUpper.times(sign).greaterThanOrEqualTo(0) || best === null
  128:             ? { value: upper, residual: atUpper }
  129:             : best
  130:           : { value: upper, residual: atUpper };
  131:       return {
  132:         status: "converged",
  133:         value: candidate.value,
  134:         residual: candidate.residual,
  135:         iterations: iteration,
  136:         trace,
  137:         discontinuity: true,
  138:       };
  139:     }
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   return { status: "did_not_converge", iterations: options.maxIterations, lower, upper, trace };
  143: }
  144: 
  145: export function defaultSolverOptions(
  146:   lowerBound: number,
  147:   upperBound: number,
  148: ): BisectionOptions {
  149:   return {
  150:     lowerBound: new Dec(lowerBound) as DecimalValue,
  151:     upperBound: new Dec(upperBound) as DecimalValue,
  152:     absoluteTolerance: new Dec("0.005") as DecimalValue,
  153:     intervalTolerance: new Dec("0.005") as DecimalValue,
  154:     maxIterations: 200,
  155:     monotonicity: "monotone_increasing",
  156:     preference: "smallest_meeting_target",
  157:   };
  158: }

### packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/refinance.ts
   50:   const oldLoan = runLedger(oldInput);
   51:   const newLoan = runLedger(newInput);
   52: 
   53:   const horizon = Math.min(oldLoan.rows.length, newLoan.rows.length);
   54:   const upfront = d(costs.upfrontCash);
   55:   const cashback = d(costs.cashback);
   56: 
   57:   const cumulativeDelta: Array<{ date: ISODate; delta: DecimalValue }> = [];
   58:   let oldCum = d(0);
   59:   let newCum = upfront; // cash paid at switch counts against the new scenario
   60:   let cashbackApplied = false;
   61: 
   62:   for (let i = 0; i < horizon; i += 1) {
   63:     const oldRow = oldLoan.rows[i]!;
   64:     const newRow = newLoan.rows[i]!;
   65:     oldCum = oldCum.plus(oldRow.payment).plus(oldRow.extraPayment).plus(oldRow.fees) as DecimalValue;
   66:     newCum = newCum.plus(newRow.payment).plus(newRow.extraPayment).plus(newRow.fees) as DecimalValue;
   67:     if (!cashbackApplied && (!costs.cashbackDate || newRow.date >= costs.cashbackDate)) {
   68:       newCum = newCum.minus(cashback) as DecimalValue;
   69:       cashbackApplied = true;
   70:     }
   71:     // Residual balances make the comparison economic, not cash-flow-only.
   72:     const delta = oldCum
   73:       .plus(oldRow.closingBalance)
   74:       .minus(newCum)
   75:       .minus(newRow.closingBalance) as DecimalValue;
   76:     cumulativeDelta.push({ date: newRow.date, delta });
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   // Â§13.10: the primary break-even is the first crossing that stays
   80:   // non-negative; earlier temporary crossings are disclosed as reversals.

1. P1 - packages/engine-au-tax/src/liability.ts:91 - Medicare returns a full 2% levy when low-income rules are null and an admitted approximation for family reductions, allowing incomplete statutory data to produce successful liabilities. Fix: fail closed for missing or unsupported reduction rules until the exact family worksheet is implemented.

2. P1 - packages/engine-au-tax/src/liability.ts:146 / packages/engine-au-tax/src/engine.ts:215 - MLS omits reportable super and spouse surcharge-income additions, while STSL omits net investment losses and exempt foreign employment income, understating tiers and repayments against the [ATO repayment-income definition](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/study-and-training-support-loans-rates-and-repayment-thresholds?page=1). Fix: extend the input schema with every statutory income component and use a shared complete income-test calculation.

3. P1 - packages/engine-au-tax/src/engine.ts:277 - Period earnings include annual bonuses and unrelated assessable income, incorrectly spreading them through Schedule 1 instead of excluding non-payroll income and processing bonuses under [Schedule 5](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/working-out-the-withholding-amount). Fix: calculate Schedule 1 withholding from ordinary period earnings only and model bonus withholding separately.

4. P1 - packages/engine-au-tax/src/net-to-gross.ts:47 - The solver assumes net income is monotone even though an uninsured MLS tier crossing applies a whole-income surcharge and creates a downward net-income cliff, so bisection can miss the smallest valid gross. Fix: partition the search at liability discontinuities, search each monotone interval, and select the smallest verified solution.

5. P1 - packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/ledger.ts:228 - All dated events are deferred to the next repayment and applied before the entire period's interest, back-applying mid-period rate and offset changes without a configurable or recorded ordering convention. Fix: split accrual periods at event dates or reject non-boundary events, then expose and record the selected event order.

6. P1 - packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/ledger.ts:91 - Negative offset balances and effectiveness values outside 0 to 1 are accepted, allowing an offset to increase interest or receive more than 100% effectiveness despite the interest-base floor. Fix: validate opening balances, event amounts, and effectiveness at the engine boundary and enforce a non-negative offset after every event.

7. P1 - packages/engine-mortgage-ledger/src/refinance.ts:53 - Refinance comparison pairs rows by array index to the shorter schedule and includes residual balances in every cumulative delta, so differing dates or frequencies are misaligned and break-even is not the specified cash-flow crossing. Fix: merge cash flows by calendar date, compute cash-only break-even, and include residual balances only at an explicit common horizon.

8. P1 - apps/web/components/home/refinance-calculator.tsx:59 - The UI accepts cashback without a receipt date or conditions, causing the engine to count every entered cashback at the first repayment. Fix: require a cashback date and reviewed-condition acknowledgement before passing a non-zero cashback.

9. P1 - apps/web/components/breadth/loan-calculator.tsx:49 - A car-loan balloon changes only the displayed repayment while the worker schedule, total interest, total paid, and payoff date remain those of a no-balloon loan. Fix: run the balloon through `buildLoanSchedule` or add balloon support to the ledger and derive every displayed metric from that schedule.

10. P1 - apps/web/lib/use-ledger.ts:51 - Starting a new worker job preserves the preceding result, and consumers ignore `running`, so changed inputs remain paired with stale results until the worker responds. Fix: clear the result when the job changes or bind each rendered result to the current job identifier.

11. P2 - apps/web/components/breadth/savings-calculator.tsx:57 - Savings-goal contributions are rounded to nearest cents and solved against the closed form, so the simulated cent-rounded schedule can finish below the stated target. Fix: solve against the period simulation and round the required contribution upward to the next cent.

12. P2 - packages/rules-au/src/packs/au-stsl-2026-27.json:44 / packages/rules-au/src/packs/au-stamp-duty-nsw.json:55 - Pack continuity fails because the STSL carry-forward base is $9,028 instead of $9,028.35 and the NSW duty base is $1,662 instead of $1,662.50. Fix: store exact bases or encode the source's base-rounding rule explicitly and test both sides of every boundary.

13. CLEAN - packages/engine-au-tax/src/liability.ts:24 - Progressive brackets, LITO taper and non-refundable cap, MLS child increments after the first child, and exact STSL `> threshold` semantics match the populated pack values.

14.
